name: Scott Baugh
subject: September Wrap-Up
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Scott Baugh for Congress
body:
|
---
| |
---
| Peter,

We are in the final stretch of our race, and we are excited! September was a beautiful month on the campaign trail, and we are deeply humbled and honored by the outpouring of support we have received. We are ready to rock and roll as ballots will be in your mailbox in less than a week! This election is incredibly important not just for Orange County but for the entire nation. Make sure your vote counts by double-checking that your registration is up-to-date with the Orange County Registrar of Voters and remember—Vote Early! Thank you for standing with us during this crucial time. Let’s continue to push forward together and make sure that when election day comes, we leave nothing on the table. The future of our community depends on it!
---
| | [ ](https://baughforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c960c16667ac69bd188629a19&id=ac0fa6e757&e=8a657725d1)
---
**Our interns are the lifeline of our campaign. Without them, things wouldn’t run as smoothly. Their hard work and dedication to making a difference in our community inspire me on the campaign trail. Our country’s future looks brighter because of our young leaders. Join our intern program in the final stretch of the campaign by visiting baughforcongress.com!**
|
---
**We live in the greatest country in the world - the United States. I am proud to fight for the opportunity to represent you in CA-47. We must preserve the freedoms that we have and make it easier for you to pursue the American Dream!**
|
---
**Noble Cause Foundation, based in Orange County, pays tribute to our veterans and their enormous sacrifices. The founder Cornell Iliescu, a survivor of the Ploesti bombing raids during WWII, was inspired to start this foundation after he escaped Romanian communists in 1970. I am thankful to Cornell for giving me the opportunity to engage with our military and veteran community and share my deepest gratitude to those who fight for the freedoms we have today. When I am elected to CA-47, our military and veterans can always count on me to advocate for them in Congress.**
|
---
**Thank you to all the incredible individuals who are working tirelessly and standing up to fight for Huntington Beach. Our home is a special place, and when I get elected, I will do everything to protect the values that make Surf City special. California is ready for a comeback!**
|
---
**A heat wave will not stop us from flipping CA-47 to red! Thank you to our interns and volunteers for canvassing throughout the weekends sharing our vision for a brighter future. We engaged with residents about the issues that matter: crime, education, and cost of living.**
|
---
**The whole country is watching our race for CA-47 because we have the momentum to flip this seat. Thank you House Majority Leader Steve Scalise for speaking at our event and supporting our campaign. I appreciate our gracious hosts, co-hosts, and vendors who helped make this night a huge success. Donate today and help me keep our House majority by going to baughforcongress.com!**
|
---
**It is deeply important to me that we as leaders invest in the next generation. And we must empower the next generation to take ownership of their own future, by teaching them the importance of voting, civic engagement, and the issues that face us today. To the students who are stepping up to be leaders in their communities, thank you, and together let’s create a brighter community today and tomorrow.**
|
---
**Our veterans’ courage and dedication to our country have always deeply inspired me, and as your congressman, I am committed to ensuring our veterans receive the respect, care, and benefits they deserve. They have made immense sacrifices so that we can enjoy the freedoms that we have today. That is why I am proud to be endorsed by Concerned Veterans for America.**
| [ ](https://baughforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c960c16667ac69bd188629a19&id=570fae5b61&e=8a657725d1)
---
**CA-47 is ready for change! If you do the crime, you do the time. Providing the resources our law enforcement needs to keep our communities safe will be my top priority when I am elected. As your congressman, public safety is something I will never compromise on.**
|
---
**This month was Hispanic Heritage month! Let us appreciate and celebrate the culture, history, and contributions our Hispanic community have made that helped shaped the United States. Feliz mes de la herencia hispana!**
|
---
**Thank you Councilmember Noah Blom for hosting such a fantastic event in Newport Beach! It was a privilege to have Larry Elder and former Assemblyman and Huntington Beach Mayor Tony Strickland introduce me and share why it is critical for us to keep the House majority. Our community is demanding change, and I will deliver that as your next congressman.**
| [ ](https://baughforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c960c16667ac69bd188629a19&id=d0a0f984b7&e=8a657725d1)
---
**I believe in restoring the American Dream. We as a nation have come too far, too many people have made too many sacrifices, to watch this dream slip away. The American Dream is real, it is why we wake up every day to fight for our country, and as your next congressman, it is my commitment to you. **
|
---
**We honored the incredible courage of Mahsa Amini on the two year anniversary of her murder. I will always stand with the people of Iran in their fight for Women, Life, and Freedom against the Iranian regime. May Mahsa’s legacy live on in all of us.**
|
---
**Thank you to the Iranian-American community for hosting a powerful event in honor of Mahsa Amini. Through the heart of every human beats the desire for freedom, and your courage and strength in the face of oppression inspire me. I will always support you in your fight for justice against the Iranian regime.**
| [ ](https://baughforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c960c16667ac69bd188629a19&id=302262fd24&e=8a657725d1)
---
**On September 17, 1787, the United States Constitution was signed in Philadelphia. Without our Constitution, we would not have our freedom of speech, the right to vote, and our equal rights and protections under the law. Take the time to study our United States Constitution. I guarantee you that when you study history, you will be appreciative of the patriotic fabrics that make the United States the best country in the world. As a proud constitutional conservative, I am committed to upholding and defending the principles of liberty, limited government, and individual rights as your next congressman.**
|
---
**Standing up for parental rights in education and advocating for school choice to empower families in selecting the best educational path are cornerstones of a successful community. Parents are the ultimate stakeholders in their children’s lives, and as your congressman, I will always put families first.**
| [ ](https://baughforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c960c16667ac69bd188629a19&id=59c29883db&e=8a657725d1)
---
**Our retirees dedicated their lives to hard work and rely on social security for reliable income after retirement. As your congressman, I will protect social security without raising costs. We owe our retirees a stable and secure future. **
|
---
**Eleven years ago, Laguna Beach Police Officer Jon Coutchie was killed in the line of duty in a motorcycle crash while searching for a speeding vehicle that had evaded other officers. I will always be grateful for our law enforcement officers who show up every day to protect us, knowing they might not return home to their families. Every day, let us honor Officer Coutchie’s bravery, service, and dedication to our community.**
|
---
**Keeping taxes low, reducing government regulations, and maintaining a safe community is the bedrock of a strong and prosperous community, and what I will always fight for as your Congressman. I am honored to have been invited to promote those values at the North American Real Estate Academy. Homeownership is part of the American Dream.**
|
---
**Teaching the next generation about civic engagement and our constitutional duty to understand the foundations and patriotic fabric of America is a responsibility I hold dear. The future of our country is at stake, and I cherish the opportunity to educate upcoming leaders in CA-47 about the incredible chance they have to shape their own future.**
| | [ ](https://baughforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c960c16667ac69bd188629a19&id=e2132267a2&e=8a657725d1)
---
**In 2020, I lost my dearest younger brother, Randy, and the most heartbreaking part is that it could have been prevented. No one should have to endure the pain of losing a loved one to fentanyl. Sadly, my family is not the only one that has faced this tragedy due to these poisonings. Addressing the opioid epidemic will be my top priority as your Congressman. We need policies that protect families in our community.**
|
---
**Thank you to the U.S. Chamber of Commerce for your endorsement! I’m committed to championing pro-business policies that create jobs, curb inflation, and boost our economy. You can count on me to be a strong advocate for our business community in D.C**

Hey friends,
We’ve asked a lot from you, so I wanted to make sure we took a moment to let you know just how appreciative we are. **Thank you for getting us through EOQ and showing the strength of our grassroots momentum.**
Today is a tough day for Nevadans and a reminder of why the work we’re doing is so critical. Seven years ago, Las Vegas suffered the deadliest mass shooting in our nation’s history. We remember and honor those we lost and the lives forever changed by this tragedy.
_Just one life lost to gun violence is one too many. Thoughts and prayers alone are not enough._

**Nevada Democrats will never subscribe to the belief that gun violence should be accepted as a fact of life.** We are committed to advancing common-sense gun violence prevention reforms on the local, state, and federal level for the loved ones lost, the survivors, their families, and every single Nevadan.

Nevada will decide this election — we have the power in our hands to elect champions who will put public safety ahead of the gun lobby’s interests. They have deep pockets and are willing to throw millions of dollars to keep the status quo, but I know we will win because we have you on our side.

Thanks for being part of the team and investing in our future victories.

— DMM
P.S. In-person early voting begins in just 18 days and active registered voters can expect ballots in the mail soon! We’re gearing up for GOTV and with 35 days to Election Day there’s no time to waste.

Nevada is a critical battleground state for Democrats to keep the Senate and White House in 2024. Unlike Republicans with their war chest full of dark money, we rely on grassroots supporters for the resources needed to win.

The battle for the Senate is in high gear and the outcome will have major implications for our nation irrespective who wins the White House. Here's an update on eight of the top U.S. Senate races: **TEXAS **– Senator **Ted Cruz** (R) faces Congressman **Colin Allred** (D) who is backed by a mountain of liberal cash. Senate Democrats named Cruz as their #1 Target to flip a state from red to blue. A recent Emerson College poll shows that Allred's cash has pushed him to within 4 points. Now Ted Cruz is out with TV ads that expose how Colin Allred voted against a bill to keep boys out of girls' sports. **MONTANA** – Ex-Navy SEAL **Tim Sheehy** (R) is challenging incumbent Senator **Jon Tester** (D) in the race that could strip the Democrats of their majority. Tester is the #1 recipient of lobbyist money and he's been a rubber stamp for the Biden-Harris agenda. Tester has tricked Montana voters for years, but they aren't being fooled this time. The Real Clear Politics polling average has Sheehy leading Tester by 5 points, which has Democrats on high alert. **WISCONSIN** – Businessman **Eric Hovde** (R) is challenging incumbent Senator **Tammy Baldwin** (D) in a presidential battleground state. Unlike many vulnerable Democrats running this year, Baldwin has actually embraced Kamala Harris and her extreme positions. Despite being attacked with millions on the other side, Hovde is exposing Baldwin's record and making the case for change. He trailed by 8 points back in June, but cut Baldwin's lead down to 4 points. **NEVADA** – Combat Army veteran **Sam Brown** (R) is challenging incumbent Senator **Jacky Rosen** (D). Brown nearly burned to death after he and his soldiers were ambushed by the Taliban, and his vehicle hit a roadside bomb. But after 3 years and 30 surgeries, he recovered and is now running for the U.S. Senate. Brown trails Rosen by single digits according to recent polls, but the race will tighten as Brown spends his war chest and voters learn about the choice they have in this race.

Friend—Last night I debated Tim Sheehy and I’m fired up. **More than ever, I’m convinced that we are going to win this race.**
Last night, Montanans saw Tim Sheehy clearly for what he is: **An out-of-state multimillionaire who can’t be trusted to defend our Montana way of life.**
Mitch McConnell knows that his ultra-wealthy handpicked candidate can’t beat a third-generation Montana dirt farmer so he’s spending nearly $90 million to tear me down.

I'm always in my "Florida!!!" era, friend. (Yes, I love Taylor Swift, even if my kids think I'm too old to be a Swiftie!)
It's pretty cool to have a song written about your own state — and even cooler when it's written by Taylor Swift. So, before I ask you **[to chip in $5 to my campaign ahead of my first $500k goal of the month](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/94077308/502457241/1820369458?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk2045-fr-nd&recurring=1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDYvMS8xMDc1MjUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNDEzNGIyMWMtNjQ4MC1lZjExLTg0NzQtNjA0NWJkYThhYWU5IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=fm-HPG-_qLYy-9nOyU3WEXlMN--0YHovKAeUTXsY2Bg=)** , can I have a moment to share my own "Love Story" with Florida, and why running to defeat Rick Scott is so important to me?
I remember stepping outside of the airport when I first visited my sister in Florida and immediately falling in love with everything, from the lively, diverse communities to the wonderful humidity and greenery. There was something so warm and welcoming about the Sunshine State — and I knew "All Too Well" that this would eventually be my home, too.
I've had the incredible privilege of building a beautiful life here. This is where I fell in love, raised a family of my own, and began dedicating my career to serving this state. I've helped to protect Florida's wildlife, preserve our coral reefs, and lead new programs to improve access to affordable health care for Floridians — and this was all before I even ran for office and became the first South American immigrant in Congress. In the House:
* I wrote the bill to expand seniors' Medicare Advantage coverage to ensure more Americans could get the care they deserve.

* I worked with Republicans to provide economic relief to families and small businesses.

* I secured $200 million for Everglades restoration.

* I fought tirelessly for commonsense gun safety reforms and served as the vice chair of the Gun Violence Prevention Task Force.

I've spent my life serving this state and getting to know the communities who call it home. But my opponent, Rick Scott, has spent his career scamming Floridians, lying to voters, and making himself richer. Friend, he really is "The Smallest Man Who Ever Lived."

While I'm fighting to improve Florida, he's focused on taking away our rights and freedoms.
Listen, I _know_ the tides are turning and Florida is ready to finally flip blue. I can see it in the polling data: Rick Scott's approval rating is going down, while I'm catching up to him in the polls. But it doesn't change the fact that I'm going up against his massive fortune — and right now, he's putting everything he's got into defeating me.
So, friend, I'm counting on you to choose unity, progress, and kindness over Rick Scott's extremist agenda. So here's my final question for you: "...Ready For It?"

Peter-
Tonight, Tim Walz showed us why he is the best choice for Vice President and that he will be an incredible partner to Kamala Harris if we elect them next month. The Harris/Walz ticket has a plan to fight for a new way forward, protecting fundamental freedoms - not the least of which includes reproductive freedoms - and holding the line against Donald Trump’s dystopian Project 2025.
Meanwhile, J.D. Vance literally wrote the foreword to Project 2025 and is more concerned with making up baseless, prejudiced lies against immigrants and disparaging women who choose not to have children than he is with actually coming up with common-sense plans and solutions for the American people.
Tim Walz is principled, smart, and understands that the American people are tired of the made-up stories, chaos and division that J.D Vance and Donald Trump are selling. He will be prepared and energized to work on behalf of Americans on day one.
It’s up to all of us to do our part to ensure that on January 20th, 2025, we’ll be able to watch Kamala Harris and Tim Walz sworn in as President and Vice President to begin their work of leading us into a new era. Please join the MassDems in our efforts to reach as many voters as possible.

Here's the thing: if we are going to deliver on Kamala’s vision for a future where every American can thrive, we need to win more than the White House. We must elect Democrats up and down the ballot and win seats in state legislatures across our country.
I’ve served as Governor of Minnesota with a Democratic majority in the state legislature and without it. So trust me – I know how important it is to have strong Democratic partners in state legislatures. Because it’s not just JD Vance and Donald Trump who share an extreme vision for our country – Republicans in state legislatures will do everything to pass their agenda in statehouses across the country. So that is why it is critical we elect proud Democrats in state legislatures who will fight for our future and deliver results for the people of their states.

subject: Tim Walz is a fearless leader who is ready to serve
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Giffords PAC; not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee
body:
During tonight’s debate, you got to see the Tim Walz I’ve come to admire over the last 18 years.
#

Hi friends, it’s Gabby Giffords.
If you just tuned into the vice presidential debate, I am sure you are as proud of Tim Walz as I am. Tonight, you all got to see the Tim Walz I’ve come to admire over the last 18 years. Since we were sworn into the House together nearly 20 years ago, I have known Tim to be the caring, passionate, and fearless leader we saw on the debate stage.
[**Tonight, Tim Walz proved exactly why this country needs Kamala Harris in the White House. If you’re ready to join my team and I at GIFFORDS PAC in making the Harris-Walz administration a reality, please make a contribution to fuel our get out the vote efforts in these last critical weeks before Election Day.**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-oct24.iFm2sk&refcode=em241001-1-30&t=1&akid=9098%2E3935704%2E3mV1CQ)
**[DONATE NOW](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-oct24.iFm2sk&refcode=em241001-1-30&t=2&akid=9098%2E3935704%2E3mV1CQ)**
Like me and a vast majority of gun owners, Vice President Kamala Harris and Tim Walz support the Second Amendment and support common sense laws that keep American communities safe. A Harris-Walz administration will fight the gun lobby and close dangerous loopholes that let guns fall into the wrong hands.
Tonight, JD Vance claimed that he cares about our nation’s gun violence epidemic. But as a Senator, he has consistently voted against commonsense gun safety legislation—including implementing universal background checks and banning bump stocks.
Both Donald Trump and JD Vance have a track record of putting gun lobby profits over our safety, and we can be sure that a Trump-Vance administration would roll back all of the progress we’ve made in our gun safety movement.
[**Our right to safety depends on electing Kamala Harris and Tim Walz next month. So please, can I count on you to join me in supporting the Harris-Walz campaign after Tim Walz’s successful debate performance by donating $3 to GIFFORDS PAC?**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-oct24.iFm2sk&refcode=em241001-1-30&t=3&akid=9098%2E3935704%2E3mV1CQ)

Tim Walz and JD Vance met for their first and only Vice Presidential debate. Below I provide a comprehensive analysis on 10 of the most salient questions and subjects. We have a lot to cover so let's dive in. Likewise, please consider subscribing to support my work and advocacy. **Let 's Address This.**

| [](https://substack.com/redirect/b812e7ab-3801-4278-9b8b-d2feafc704e4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

## Question 1: Preemptive strike on Iran?
Before I address either answer, I found it disturbing that the opening question readily assumed that preemptive strikes are on the table. If the Bush doctrine with Iraq has taught us anything, igniting war leads to mass death and destruction--not peace. I've made no secret about my disdain for Biden's policies in arming Netanyahu--[despite staunch opposition from the American people](https://substack.com/redirect/5399b018-78b6-4657-9a9b-6ad9a2b17b42?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), and [in violation of international human rights law](https://substack.com/redirect/e4bdba6b-0015-4173-8675-d8b48fb33f85?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Accordingly, I'm not confident either candidate gave the strong answer I would have liked to hear. The right answer, in my view is that we must uphold international human rights law, and the US Leahy Laws, stop arming Netanyahu with offensive weapons, and deescalate. This includes a permanent ceasefire, immediate release of all hostages, and rebuilding of Gaza.
Governor Walz began by referencing the 10/7 Hamas attack "that killed 1,400 Israelis," stressing the need for steady leadership in the face of such crises. He criticized Trump for focusing on trivial matters, like crowd sizes, while pointing out that even Trump's closest associates have labeled him as flawed and dangerous. Walz contrasted this with Harris's steady leadership, underscoring the importance of maintaining strong alliances, especially as Trump has leaned towards figures like Putin. He concluded by affirming that there would be serious consequences for Iran.
Vance opened by sharing his personal experience of needing food assistance. I found this ironic [given his opposition to such programs as Senator](https://substack.com/redirect/744607e2-9ae0-4d65-b070-8e380752405c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). He then emphasized the chaos in the world and argued that Trump would restore stability. Vance falsely claimed that Iran received $100 billion from the Harris administration, [though the funds were actually unfrozen in 2016 under Obama as part of the bipartisan Iran nuclear deal](https://substack.com/redirect/f0ba04c5-e3cd-4837-8e22-c0ab5a56ebc6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). He stated that Israel should decide how to respond to Iran, while reiterating Trump's "peace through strength" approach. This is also a fabrication given Trump dramatically increased drone strikes and extrajudicial killings globally--[spiking civilian murders by 330%](https://substack.com/redirect/8ab4a296-2fa1-43f7-b5c3-3a884c8341e9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
## Question 2: Climate Change
Vance stated that both he and Trump support clean air and water. This is a lie, given Trump's record of [gutting the EPA's environmental regulations](https://substack.com/redirect/bfe91152-cf5f-4ba9-a4eb-253dc90d93ff?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) including rolling back more than 125 environmental safeguards, [removing the United States from the Paris Climate Accords](https://substack.com/redirect/64a8a5d0-e28e-4f0c-8ee3-3310efef9cb0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), and calling Climate Change a "[Chinese hoax](https://substack.com/redirect/8411e6e1-d390-416f-a8f8-8e5d6a24c857?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)." Vance likewise claimed that Harris has increased U.S. energy dependence on China and outsourced American manufacturing--both of which are also lies.
Walz highlighted that Trump has repeatedly called climate change a hoax, while contrasting that stance with the significant progress made under the Inflation Reduction Act (IRA), which represents the largest climate investment in global history. He emphasized that the IRA has created 200,000 jobs in the U.S. and noted that the country is now producing more clean energy than ever before, showing that addressing climate change and creating jobs are not mutually exclusive goals. Additionally, Walz pointed out that the U.S. is producing more natural gas and oil than ever before, again criticizing Trump for dismissing climate change as a hoax, a point Vance refused to address.
## Question 3: The Immigration Crisis
Following in Donald Trump's fascist steps, JD Vance demonized immigrants dozens of times during the 90 minute debate. Here, I debunk his most oft repeated lies about immigrants.
* There's no "invasion." Notwithstanding the absurdity of labeling immigrants as "invaders," [undocumented crossings are at a three year ](https://substack.com/redirect/f53eb3e0-b5d4-4135-8aa5-25dbf6074922?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_[low](https://substack.com/redirect/f53eb3e0-b5d4-4135-8aa5-25dbf6074922?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). _Vance claimed there are 25M undocumented immigrants, then refused to explain how they would actually be deported, despite being reminded he'd previously laughed at the proposal as farcicle.
* Far from record crime rates as Vance alleged, [America's murder rates are at historic lows](https://substack.com/redirect/1a3e0ce9-b65a-46e5-86a2-7d5c3b704ef4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), and falling. Vance also never mentions that murder rates are [40% higher in red states than in blue states](https://substack.com/redirect/cdd2f42f-8075-419a-baec-cb2fd02502da?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), and 8 of the top 10 states with highest murder rates are red states. This is in part due to failed "tough on crime" policies that red states espouse. Vance demonizes immigrants to avoid dealing with failed Republican policies.
* Vance ignores that Trump is on record that he wants [more white immigrants from 'nice' countries like Norway](https://substack.com/redirect/411ef999-ad90-43ef-a289-9b8149bd76c5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), but condemns immigrants from _"[sh*thole countries](https://substack.com/redirect/79a2a810-531b-47cd-9305-4d3fe4dfc748?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg),_" i.e. his pejorative for Haiti and African countries. Vance also ignores that when Congress had a bipartisan immigration bill--[Trump told GOP to kill it](https://substack.com/redirect/326776f3-969e-4761-81b8-9341087faa2f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). When asked why Trump killed the bill, Vance repeatedly refused to answer.
* Immigrants, including undocumented immigrants, have significantly lower crime rates than do born U.S. citizens. This has in fact always been the case. You are statistically safer living next to an immigrant than you are living next to a born U.S. citizen. In fact, a study over a 150 year period found that [immigrants have ](https://substack.com/redirect/a21f0ce9-a53d-4148-95e2-148459be866d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_[never](https://substack.com/redirect/a21f0ce9-a53d-4148-95e2-148459be866d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_[had a higher crime rate than born U.S. citizens](https://substack.com/redirect/a21f0ce9-a53d-4148-95e2-148459be866d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
* And while Vance blames immigrants for fentanyl and firearms, the facts tell a different story. Border Patrol itself [reports](https://substack.com/redirect/72d7cafc-1d2e-4653-8992-2551fea1fd43?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that 90% of fentanyl comes through registered border crossings, more than 50% is smuggled in by US citizens, and virtually none is brought in by asylum seekers. On firearms, [more than 70% were smuggled from the US](https://substack.com/redirect/8345afe7-4541-4ba5-98ac-58d049197f3b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), not Mexico. Our gun violence is being exported to Mexico, not being imported from Mexico.
* Finally, contrary to Vance's claim that immigrants cost American workers jobs and wages, studies repeatedly show that[ immigrants (including undocumented immigrants) increase worker pay for US citizens](https://substack.com/redirect/fe140f77-9b8f-4bf4-844a-48b3f862a194?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).

## Question 4: Economy and Deficits
Walz acknowledged the struggles of the middle class and highlighted an Opportunity Economy, which includes building 3 million new homes, offering $25K down payment assistance, and ensuring affordable housing. He criticized Trump for cutting taxes for the wealthy, which added $8 trillion to the national debt, and called for the wealthy to pay their fair share. Walz also pointed out Trump's mishandling of the economy during the COVID crisis, which led to 10 million job losses. He emphasized the importance of listening to experts and criticized Trump for avoiding paying taxes.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/e3153054-07ad-4cc8-ae3f-b5366e5b9d22?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Vance defended Trump's tax cuts, arguing that they were beneficial to working-class Americans, even though they contributed to an increase in the national deficit. He criticized Harris for not enacting her proposed plans during her term, despite the fact that much of this process is controlled by Congress. Vance claimed manufacturing was booming under Trump and struggling under Biden. As the above graphic shows, this is a lie, and the opposite is true. Vance also claimed that under Trump, Americans experienced the highest take-home pay in a generation. This is a lie, and [Americans experienced a 3X higher increase in take home pay under Obama than under Trump](https://substack.com/redirect/c069be65-f003-46dc-9321-0bce4b534382?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
## Question 5: Reproductive Rights
Walz firmly rejected claims that he supports 9th-month abortions, instead highlighted Trump's significant role in overturning Roe v. Wade. He also pointed to the dangerous implications of Project 2025's proposed pregnancy registry and the skyrocketing maternal mortality rates in states like Texas. Walz underscored Minnesota's top healthcare ranking, attributing it to the state's trust in women and doctors to make personal medical decisions. He shared the story of Amber Thurman, stressing that a woman's right to control her own body should not depend on geography. Walz reiterated his strong support for women's freedom to make their own choices and praises Harris's efforts to make childcare more affordable for families.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/3961f8cd-39c9-4d93-b0f5-1fc1191cf5ab?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Vance claimed to support pro-family policies, though his voting record contradicts many of these claims. He advocated for states' rights to determine abortion policy, despite previously supporting a national ban after 15 weeks. While he now denies having ever backed such a ban, his website before July 17 explicitly stated his support for it. Vance knows he's on the wrong side of this issue so he lied repeatedly to try to cover his tracks. He failed.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/c3c67d25-6571-483f-889f-7b60edf1618a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
JD Vanc'es website before July 17, calling to end all abortion access.
## Question 6: Gun Control
Vance opposes red flag laws and most gun control measures, instead attributing gun violence primarily to mental health issues and substance abuse. This is a lie. The data shows that [mental illness is not in any way a cause of gun violence](https://substack.com/redirect/70a3249c-306c-404a-be0f-63ccde8dad23?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), and instead people with mental health issues are much more likely to be victims of gun violence than perpetrators of it. Vance wants to turn our schools into fortresses. This is not only absurd, there's no evidence that such an approach actually works.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/a7072808-d523-4228-9757-4938252b9204?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Walz instead emphasized the need for common-sense gun safety laws, criticizing Republicans for blocking even basic research on gun violence. He advocated for measures that would reduce gun-related deaths, pointing out that other countries have effectively addressed school shootings through stricter regulations. Walz underscores the importance of balancing Second Amendment rights with the safety of children and communities, arguing that responsible gun laws can prevent unnecessary tragedies without infringing on individual freedoms. He also spoke to the fact that the highest gun death rates are not in big cities, as Vance alleged, but in rural parts of America where gun related suicides are extremely high.
## Question 7: Inflation and Housing
Vance repeated the false claim that immigrants were driving up home prices and receiving free housing. He advocated for using federal lands to develop housing but would not even provide a concept of a plan for how this would have worked.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/944fce76-cac0-4235-accf-ee8b2f9ea52b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Walz emphasized a more structured approach to tackling the housing crisis, focusing on building 3 million new homes and providing $25,000 in down payment assistance to help stabilize the market. He pointed to Minnesota's success in implementing similar strategies and argued that these solutions could be applied on a national scale. Walz also condemned the scapegoating of immigrants for rising home prices, calling for real solutions rather than divisive rhetoric that ignored the root causes of the housing shortage.
## Question 8: Healthcare
Vance claimed that Trump lowered prescription drug prices and increased healthcare access during his presidency. Both these claims are a lie, because both of these improvements were largely the result of the Affordable Care Act (ACA), which Trump repeatedly tried to repeal via vote and via SCOTUS. In fact, Republicans have tried to repeal the ACA [a shocking 100 times](https://substack.com/redirect/7cdfc012-a335-496c-884f-0acad4e7e439?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Vance also insisted that preexisting conditions would be covered under his healthcare plan, though he once again provided no specific details on how this would be achieved.
Walz responded by pointing out Trump's numerous attempts to repeal the ACA, which provides protections for those with preexisting conditions. He emphasized that it was only John McCain's decisive vote that prevented the repeal, underscoring the ongoing threat to healthcare access under Trump's leadership. He also pointed out that under the current administration, Medicare was finally able to negotiate drug pricing and bring down the cost of insulin and other drugs for the first time in history.
## Question 9: Childcare
Walz highlighted Minnesota's success in implementing paid family leave, supporting childcare workers, and fostering a strong economy that benefits families. He emphasized how these initiatives have helped both families and businesses thrive, and called for similar national policies that reflect these values, ensuring that all families across the country can benefit from these kinds of supports.
In contrast, Vance did not offer any specific solutions to address the childcare crisis. Again, not even a concept of a plan.
## Question 10: State of Democracy
Vance defended his decision to challenge the 2020 election results, bizarrely placing the blame on censorship and big tech for undermining democracy. He argued that peaceful protests should have been allowed, wholly ignoring the widespread violence that took place on January 6. When repeatedly asked to declare that Trump lost the 2020 election, Vance balked each time.
Walz countered by highlighting the violence of January 6, the brutal attacks on police officers, and Trump's refusal to concede the election. He criticized Vance for failing to acknowledge that Trump lost the 2020 election, a key moment in the debate that underscored Vance's unwillingness to confront the facts surrounding the outcome.
## Closing statements
Walz focused on the themes of democracy, unity, and creating an economy that works for everyone. He emphasized the importance of protecting democratic values and ensuring that all Americans have the opportunity to succeed. Walz drew on the words of Maya Angelou and Franklin D. Roosevelt, underscoring the significance of freedom and the pursuit of opportunity for all citizens, urging voters to embrace a vision of inclusion and progress.
Vance concluded by stating "we haven't talked about energy tonight," when that discussion in fact came up repeatedly. Vance closed by criticizing Harris for her handling of energy policies, the fentanyl crisis, and rising inflation, and claimed we need "new" leadership via Trump.
## Conclusion
Governor Tim Walz won the debate hands down. He started visibly nervous but settled into his teaching and coaching routine, and delivered line after line of substance and decency. I appreciated that he took time out to reject demonization of immigrants, reject demonization of people who struggle with mental health illnesses, and uplift women like Amber Thurman and tell her story. Senator JD Vance spent his time lying to the camera and demonizing immigrants. That about sums up his strategy.
As I've stated before, Donald Trump's return to the White House with a [Project 2025 agenda will invite fascism to America](https://substack.com/redirect/c18a91af-df7c-4cc1-9687-0d5c3b2059d3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). He is not to be trusted with the office of the presidency--not if we care about the economy, the environment, immigration reform, reproductive health access, and government accountability. We must see through Trumps's and Vance's smokescreen of lies, understand the real threats to our nation's future, and work with actual productive policy for economic, social, and climate justice. Reject the rhetoric. Reject the hate. Reject Donald Trump. Our country deserves better.

Here's the thing: if we are going to deliver on Kamala’s vision for a future where every American can thrive, we need to win more than the White House. We must elect Democrats up and down the ballot and win seats in state legislatures across our country.
I’ve served as Governor of Minnesota with a Democratic majority in the state legislature and without it. So trust me – I know how important it is to have strong Democratic partners in state legislatures. Because it’s not just JD Vance and Donald Trump who share an extreme vision for our country – Republicans in state legislatures will do everything to pass their agenda in statehouses across the country. So that is why it is critical we elect proud Democrats in state legislatures who will fight for our future and deliver results for the people of their states.
**We can’t win this election in 35 days without an influx of grassroots support right now.**
[We’re in the final stretch of this race, so we need a heck of a lot of folks on our side to win this thing and elect Democrats nationwide. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future. A movement is growing, led by progressives--but supported by many well-meaning Americans--to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue--views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. body:

# UPDATE
---
|
# GREAT NEWS
---

# THE CIRCULAR FIRING SQUAD STOPPED BY THE APPOMATTOX GOP
---
| After years of political persecution in Chesterfield by some establishment Republicans, I'm so thankful to have allies in Appomattox, a county that is predominately conservative grassroots Republicans, like me. This is one smart committee. They saw through the shenanigans of the former "kicked out" Chesterfield GOP Executive Committee, who were so divisive that Chesterfield went blue under their leadership. Their efforts to keep me from becoming a member of the Appomattox GOP failed.
Tonight, the members of the Appomattox GOP unanimously voted me in to join the Appomattox GOP among many witnesses, including a reporter. I'm delighted to be a member and look forward to continuing being an active supportive member of the Republican Party, doing everything I can to get our Republican Ticket elected this November and beyond.
Tonight, the Appomattox GOP put an end to the Republican circular firing squad I had experienced for over a decade in Chesterfield. I'm so thankful that instead of spending my time defending myself with endless inter-party accusations, I will now be able to focus my energy on helping Republicans win.
---
|
---
|
# EMAIL DATED 10/2/24
---
|
# HERE WE GO AGAIN
---
| | |
---|---
Here we go again. Establishment Republicans don't want me to run for state senate in Senate District 10 and are doing their best to try to stop me. It's actually election interference.

As you may remember, Chesterfield County Republicans voted in a new Chesterfield County GOP Executive Committee in March.

The Old Guard that got kicked out is ticked off and they are trying to stir things up for me again, but this time in the 5th Congressional District where I now live.

One of the former "kicked out" members who isn't even in the first or fifth district is trying to interfere in the election.

I am the front runner in this race and they are afraid of me.
They know I will win.

Just like they tried to take out President Trump and disqualify him, they are trying to do to me. Please see the documentation below as this is unfolding.
| FROM THE DESK OF FORMER STATE SENATOR AMANDA CHASE
---
|
# RESPONSE TO
# 4TH DISTRICT CHAIR'S
# INAPPROPRIATE EMAIL
---
| September, 27 2024
Dear Chairman Buchanan, As Republicans, we should all be on the same team.
My apologies in advance for the inappropriate and felonious statement from current 4th Congressional District Chair Carey Allen, who has no jurisdiction or authority on matters pertaining to the First Congressional District, where I last resided in Chesterfield for almost 25 years and before moving to the Fifth Congressional District in Appomattox, where I now reside.
Today, I am reaching out to you to set the record straight regarding false statements made by Carey Allen, who was recently dismissed as Vice Chair of the Chesterfield GOP Committee by the voters in Chesterfield who witnessed first hand her inappropriate behavior and abuse of her position. Thankfully, in March a new executive leadership team was elected overwhelmingly 3 to 1 by Republicans in Chesterfield.
Jeff Ryer, who is the current 1st Congressional District Chair and Chris Marston, GOP attorney, have advised me on several occasions, including recently, that Ms. Allen's unsigned letter stating that I was no longer able to participate in Republican Party politics was completely illegal and void and therefore no appeal was required or needed.
Jeff Ryer and Chris Marston both stated that I am fully able to participate in Republican Party politics. In a phone conversation with Jeff Ryer on September 26, Jeff stated that he would contact both you and the Appomattox Chair to correct Carey Allen's continued false statements and that I am eligible for membership.
Sadly, this is yet another nefarious attempt by Ms. Allen to insert herself in areas in which she has no authority and for the sole purpose to cast doubt on my reputation as a Republican in good standing in a community where I now reside.
I've included documented photos from my Facebook page that Carey Allen omitted showing where I did in fact support the Republican nominee for State Senate Glen Sturtevant and the entire Republican Ticket on both September 12, 2023 and November 4, 2023. In the first post I even discouraged my supporters from issuing a write-in campaign.
There's nothing wrong with asking questions of a party official who is presiding over the election process, when some campaigns are given more access to the process than others, leaving an appearance of maladministration.
I had every right to challenge then Chesterfield County Chairwoman Leslie Haley's decision to allow my opponent Senator Glen Sturtevant's campaign manager to be the sole campaign present for the certification of the early voting machines, instead of choosing a neutral Republican to oversee the process and casting a dark cloud over the process.
Our campaign went through the proper channels legally and through the party to express our concerns. In fact, Chesterfield Republicans were so upset over these actions by Ms. Haley and her executive committee to include Ms. Allen, that they were swiftly voted out of office and replaced by now Chairwoman Dee Dee VanBuren and her executive committee.
This is simply a matter of sour grapes by 4th Congressional District Chair Carey Allen. Perhaps she is upset because the slate of Chesterfield GOP candidates that I supported in the March 2024 primary won and as a result she lost her position as Vice-Chair, a position she has held for over a decade.
I have faithfully supported our Republican nominees since I first joined the Chesterfield GOP in 2008 and have been a loyal and faithful member who has worked for many of our elected members of Congress, Governor and Attorney General and as a representative of countless campaigns.
I've also served as a member of the Senate as a Republican for 8 years from 2016 through 2023. These are simply baseless allegations that should be dealt with and seen for what they are- sour grapes. Carey Allen and her executive committee failed to follow the Republican Party Plan and illegally kicked me out of the party. Here's the clencher. I was their 2019 Republican Virginia Senate nominee for Senate District 11. Thankfully, I still won despite their attempts to sabotage my campaign.
Ms. Allen has never run any of her baseless claims before the Chesterfield County Republican membership, and any meeting she did have was behind closed doors. I've never been called or asked for an explanation for any of her allegations, in violation of the Party Plan.
No vote from the Chesterfield County Republican Committee was EVER taken on her actions against me. She knew she wouldn't have the votes.
Republicans in Chesterfield got tired of her inappropriate behavior and correctly voted her out of office. She failed to have a thorough investigation of any of her claims over the years and not once took any of her assertions before the Chesterfield County Republican Committee or investigative committee for a vote. She made these decisions either on her own or behind closed doors.

Dear Chairman Buchanan,
I hope this message finds you in good health. Pursuant to the direction of Chairman Rich Anderson, I am writing to formally notify both you and the Chairman of the Appomattox County Republican Committee, Ms. Robin Wolfskill, of former Senator Amanda Chase's relocation to Appomattox County, and her intention to join the Appomattox County Republican Committee. This communication serves as formal notice of her current membership status within the Virginia GOP.
As you may be aware, Senator Chase has been previously removed from the Republican Party under the provisions of Articles I and VII of the Party Plan, resulting in two separate four-year removals. The first removal took effect on September 30, 2019, and the second on March 19, 2024. Senator Chase did not file an appeal within the 30-day period afforded for such actions, with the respective appeal deadlines of October 30, 2019, and April 19, 2024. Consequently, she is currently barred from participating in any party activities until April 19, 2028, pursuant to her most recent Article I violation.
To ensure full awareness among the necessary parties, I have copied Jeff Ryer, whose jurisdiction partially covers this matter, and who was present as a member of the Credentials Committee when Senator Chase was formally notified of her second removal during the Chesterfield County Republican Committee (CCRC) Canvas on March 19, 2024. The Credentials Committee, under the leadership of former CCRC Chairman Leslie Haley and Credentials Chairman Tara Carroll, issued the notice. Former CCRC Chairman Tara Carroll had also overseen the handling of Senator Chase's first Article I violation. For complete transparency, I have also included RPV Chairman Rich Anderson and RPV General Counsel Chris Marston in this communication.
Senator Chase's most recent four-year removal was precipitated by various social media posts in which she expressed her intent to run a write-in campaign against the then-Republican nominee, now duly elected Senator Glen Sturtevant for the 12th State Senate District. Furthermore, she publicly called for the resignation of Leslie Haley and voiced her refusal to support Senator Sturtevant, citing her belief that he was dishonorable. These statements were made during the June 26, 2023, meeting of the CCRC, addressed to the entire body prior to adjournment. It is important to note that Senator Chase had previously declared in writing her intent to support the party nominee, as required for her candidacy in the Republican Primary for Senate District 12, which was held on June 21, 2023.
If you or Ms. Wolfskill have any questions or require further clarification, please do not hesitate to contact me.
Sincerely,
Carey Allen Chair, 4th Congressional District Republican Committee

subject: MassGOP Opposes Ballot Question 5: Protecting Jobs and Small Businesses in the Restaurant Sector
body:

---
| MassGOP Opposes Ballot Question 5: Protecting Jobs and Small Businesses in the Restaurant Sector
---
---
| Boston, MA- The MassGOP strongly opposes Ballot Question 5, concerning the minimum wage for tipped workers. If enacted, this initiative would have detrimental effects on the entire restaurant industry, impacting not only the establishments but also the servers, bartenders, and patrons throughout Massachusetts. By eliminating the tipped minimum wage, the initiative would compel restaurants to pay the full minimum wage to tipped workers, significantly increasing their operating costs. This change threatens the viability of restaurants and the livelihoods of those who work in this vital sector of our economy.
Servers and bartenders already earn significantly more than the minimum wage, choosing this profession because they can make in a weekend what someone in a standard 9-to-5 job earns in a week. A survey conducted among waitstaff and bartenders revealed that 86% of respondents believe the current tipping system works for them. Additionally, 90% of those surveyed feel that eliminating tipped wages would result in lower earnings for tipped employees. Furthermore, 80% oppose a mandatory tip pool that would share tips with the kitchen and other non-service staff. An overwhelming 91% expressed a preference for the existing system, which allows for a lower base wage while providing the opportunity to earn more through tips.
Mom-and-pop dining establishments, still recovering from the effects of the pandemic, will be among the hardest hit. Introducing this additional burden will force many small restaurants to close their doors. Other establishments will have no choice but to raise their prices, ultimately leading to a more expensive dining experience for consumers.
MassGOP Chair Amy Carnevale commented on the ballot question, stating, "I can't understand who the proponents of this measure are fighting for. This ballot question harms everyone involved in the restaurant industry, particularly bartenders and waitstaff. Before making a decision, I implore voters to speak with their favorite waitress or bartender at their preferred restaurant and ask how they plan to vote."
"From owners to waitstaff, everyone in the restaurant industry opposes this measure. This ballot question doesn't benefit anyone and will make dining out--a simple pleasure in life--less affordable for Massachusetts residents. We have no right to interfere with people's livelihoods. The MassGOP stands firm in voting NO against Question 5," Carnevale concluded.
###

| | Dear Fellow American,

[**Hillsdale College has selected you to participate in its National Opinion Survey on Critical Race Theory (CRT).**](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/i1ZEFE2iPoQnxsLa0GZ95g~~/AARclAA~/RgRo369iP0SdaHR0cHM6Ly9pbmZvLmhpbGxzZGFsZS5lZHUvY3J0LXN1cnZleS8_c2M9MDE1NzJOMDI0MkwwQURPREVFUyZ1dG1fc291cmNlPXByb3NwZWN0aW5nJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPWNydHN1cnZleSZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1MT05HX1BBLVJPTi0yMDI0MTAwMlcDc3BjQgpm-GAX_WYgNzHUUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~)

I'm reaching out because you're an informed patriot who cares about this country. The situation is urgent, and your response will only take a few moments.

CRT has been around for decades.

Feminist academics used to make arguments about "unpacking their invisible knapsacks of privilege." However, at the time, CRT was rejected for being "just _another_ crazy fringe academic theory."

**Today, the situation is much different ...and much worse.**

_Now_ , CRT infiltrates our schools and workplaces. It's not so laughable for you to have to sit in a meeting or seminar that explains to you your "invisible knapsack of privilege."

To speak up often means you can lose your job, or worse...

What's frightening for the direction of this country is that federal agencies have labeled some parents who oppose CRT as "domestic terrorists."

**This should NOT be happening in America.**

Hillsdale College--where I work--teaches the principles of liberty and justice that our country was founded on. And we're fighting to defend them on the battlefield of education.

**But we need YOUR help to defend our constitutional principles against CRT.** Sharing your opinion with us is one important way you can take action.

**Complete your National Opinion Survey on Critical Race Theory now:[https://info.hillsdale.edu/crt-survey/](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/i1ZEFE2iPoQnxsLa0GZ95g~~/AARclAA~/RgRo369iP0SdaHR0cHM6Ly9pbmZvLmhpbGxzZGFsZS5lZHUvY3J0LXN1cnZleS8_c2M9MDE1NzJOMDI0MkwwQURPREVFUyZ1dG1fc291cmNlPXByb3NwZWN0aW5nJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPWNydHN1cnZleSZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1MT05HX1BBLVJPTi0yMDI0MTAwMlcDc3BjQgpm-GAX_WYgNzHUUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~)**

When you participate in our survey, you will help us gather the information needed to address CRT's threats to our liberty and find solutions that restore our constitutional principles.

When you finish taking your survey, please consider giving a generous gift.

Our NATIONAL EDUCATION CAMPAIGN--which includes _Imprimis_ , free online courses, and K-12 curriculum and school network--educates millions of citizens about our Constitution and founding principles.

We need your help expanding these initiatives. And because we do not take a single penny of taxpayer funding, even indirectly through federal and state student grants loans--all of our work is funded by informed patriots like you.

Thank you for joining us in our mission on behalf of liberty.

Warm regards,

Bill Gray, '01
Vice President
Institutional Advancement
Hillsdale College

P.S. Your participation and support are essential in our fight against CRT. Please complete the survey and consider a generous gift to help us continue our educational mission at this secure link:

[**https://info.hillsdale.edu/crt-survey/**](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/i1ZEFE2iPoQnxsLa0GZ95g~~/AARclAA~/RgRo369iP0SdaHR0cHM6Ly9pbmZvLmhpbGxzZGFsZS5lZHUvY3J0LXN1cnZleS8_c2M9MDE1NzJOMDI0MkwwQURPREVFUyZ1dG1fc291cmNlPXByb3NwZWN0aW5nJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPWNydHN1cnZleSZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1MT05HX1BBLVJPTi0yMDI0MTAwMlcDc3BjQgpm-GAX_WYgNzHUUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~)

Schulz](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsz7GOtCAQAOCngQ4zDqO4BcXf2O3fXmlYHJQLihH0svf0l1x9L_Al38dzerqY4r78dxvbGvLkfI03Ty0oVEgTydkGZmQt2bYGzWAGQJKrbbEPpu-pIx-6B8wYXqS1Cy9NaBygjBYBqQXAFsDQ0LABE6jrA2p0D-8FAc-x5rP5zHGvK4f0zjefjc-bTHat9ShC_xM4ChyLX6_0vV2Fr63J5yJwNKDe7M6iclAHu_2qReU9xZ0FjvK08_EVU4qlN4Jg2VxMv3L9-3lb_AkAAP__n0tUsQ) published his first _Peanuts_ comic. What would you do if you came face to face with a [crazy-looking full-size moose?](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsz7FuwyAQgOGnwRvR-SDGGRi6eEvXjhY1R3wV5iJDbeXtq3bu_A-_vo_7fA-cuTzew0a-JZnD0viguQeNGu1su-gTEZLpyPcO3ehGQNut3g0BIjlcAJJJZjSY8HZNyxg-zRgH7NgjoO0BsAdwdryQA5fsdUhoMNyWRVmgyE32y5dwaSul_JKD9ssiW5f92tqzKvOmcFI4yXeLInv9jQqnLZSquTQqlXRd5YxyFn1yW_UmUkk_hKo-eA9ZVyJ9ri-FU7f7-Dw5Z66DUxYeW-D8t2v_4w-PPwEAAP__tTtdiA) Would you stand your ground and tell the moose to stop crowding you? ## Texas Ports Disrupted by Dockworkers Strike
Dockworkers at the Port of Houston, Galveston, and Corpus Christi--along with others on the Gulf and Atlantic coasts--[are on strike](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLHOozAQhJ_GdBvZGwikcJGG7r_imivRYhawMN7IdkLy9ieuv2ZGmqm-78_P8EM--Lj8op1t-cwykCv-zYPRgID1UFeTHfV0NxVb02LbtaYxplqtuxp955muuuHauXlurpOZa27GzkzY6cpb1FgbrdHo5oa3Szu2jhjHDu_m1jlUtebJF0mXsnLhD-U5fOXN6eJkr4JdS3lmdX0o7BX2x3Fc9hzPT2HPEV5ZYb9L5O_ZlDYu5zKJ2w5JG6cMVOApqYDMsMorF4lAQeICTLmAkzNHXnyE1eciyTvIJfmNgTKwkyj7F1aKSwYfYaRA0bHCnhI8Hia99vi7SnZ6Hj4En2-tqvWykw__AMp_fL4t_g0AAP__AbR8Aw), causing major disruptions to supply chains as the holiday shopping season approaches. Nearly 50,000 members of the International Longshoremen's Association [stopped work at 36 U.S. ports](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx00DGPozAQBeBfYzqj8cTgULi4hi7XXomMPQQrBiN7LmT__Yrtt3nNJz09vX-P6eFiivvzr9vI8mfJk_Mc3zQpkChRT7oJdoYwqIasMmjuRnVKNavVw6CRTDDker_cfAfkA3YLAChv6NZEi4BaAaCCrse-NbPxjnC-46D6u0ehgULkXFpeienj6pK-8ptK6_PWJLsyH1Xc_ggcBY7nebZ-n_2FAserW-CoQOAISuBIrrL0-cojF66ycokvkjE5-X-PeZdnLi9ZOR9yjinFvFcZd8nFBWpX3lJTbDjOi2pvhIbn5mL62cK_XPO2-B0AAP__jttmgQ) managed by the United States Maritime Alliance on Tuesday after their demands for higher wages and a ban on automation were rebuffed. It's the union's first strike since 1977. President Biden indicated he has no intention of [helping the two sides resolve the impasse](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kL2OszAQAJ8GOiLvgn8oXHxNunztlWhtL8GKwci2ktzbn3L9laNpRvN1W24UUzzu_2ln295rXsi3-OQFxIADTsvUB-tEmKFnCxq10SAB-s16AoVOreRBuiBJSDISR9ISHAfwfbQocAIhEIRUqC7aaU-MzuAMynjsJsEhtlwubePGb6pr-s5PLhef9z7ZrbWzduO_Dq8dXuk8-FU_6gOlRZ-4w2vI_vHK5cGlDrWV-ODhzKXVISYaUj7udcuFdz6GGbQYedKzCc7PzAbBSJ7NuI5A46r6YsP5iinFqnQ3iftOMf2mtD_OPC3-BAAA__8RVmYI) or using federal law to end the strike. The Port of Houston is one of the busiest in the nation, contributing $440 billion to the GDP and supporting 1.5 million jobs in Texas.
## Failed Safety Inspection Forces Mall Closure
The Temple Mall has been [closed since Friday](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLGOszAQhJ_GdCB742AoXPwNXf72SmTsJVndghFehfD2p0S68qoZ6ZNGo-_rNt4CMa33_2FBL685jyEKPXE0uoYa7Gir5CedelOhNw5c58zVmOrhp9g7vJgwhZAiutY4bdOs4Zo6a21IFXnQYI3WYPS1hbZxk4sBYeqgN20XQVmNiSTvjTxQ8BXKzGd-4t7EvFTsHyJbUZd_CgYFw3EczfchrzdUMLy3FQy6f3enYIgkZy24bIyfyHvYic86ci5YfskSmOs5M-eD1ntdwoxy1rSWDaNQXhUM1e7TdhAzldYpq-9LIP5ckj8MPT38BAAA__8kX2oL) after failing a safety inspection due to unresolved fire code violations and problems with the facility's plumbing and electrical systems. name: Elissa Slotkin
subject: the last word
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ELISSA SLOTKIN FOR MICHIGAN
body:
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=2009%2E135344%2Ep8go7K)

Friend –
What would it be like to be an undecided voter?
As you might imagine, political scientists and psychologists have spent a lot of time studying the thought processes of undecided voters, as well as the art and science of persuasion.
And one of their key findings boils down to this: what matters is who gets the last word.
With 34 days to go and voting already in progress in Michigan (!), the information that voters are getting now may be the last thing that they hear before casting their ballot – and that information comes in various ways: through TV and digital ads, mailers to their homes, and by volunteers calling, texting, and knocking on their doors.
So with Republicans having already spent or reserved over $38 million dollars on ads in this race, and Mitch McConnell's super PAC announcing $22.5 million in additional spending this week, we have to make sure that our message is the one that breaks through, especially now as voters are casting their ballots.
[**That’s why I’m asking today: any chance you can chip in $3 to my campaign to make sure that the voters who will decide this race hear from us before they cast their ballot? It will *immediately* be put to use on getting the last word!**](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-oct24.UCjdR-&refcode=em241002-1-900&t=2&akid=2009%2E135344%2Ep8go7K)

**" Hundreds of longshoremen picket at Port of Houston as strike begins,"** Houston Chronicle's**Erica Grieder** -- "A row of ship-to-shore cranes towered silently over Trinity Bay Tuesday morning, as seagulls cawed, passing trucks honked and members of International Longshoremen's Association Local 24 chanted slogans and waved signs.

Several hundred dockworkers had hit the picket line at the Port of Houston's Bayport Container Terminal, gathering shortly after midnight. Similar actions were taking place at the Port of New York and New Jersey, the Port of Baltimore, and more than 30 other ports along the East and Gulf Coasts. The contract between the International Longshoremen's Association and the United States Maritime Alliance, a group of carriers, employers and port associations, had expired at 12:00 AM, Eastern Time, at which point the ILA went on strike for the first time since 1977.

Although the ILA had asked union members not to speak to media, it had issued a statement for distribution.

"Due to corporate greed, employers refuse to compensate the ILA's members fairly," the statement said. "Over the last several years, the net revenues of these companies have grown astronomically from hundreds of millions to billions of dollar while the ILA members' wage increases do not even cover the cost of inflation."

Automation is, along with wages, the other key issue behind the strike. The ILA is seeking a ban on automated cranes, gates and container-moving trucks.

"Employers push automation under the guise of safety, but it is really about cutting labor costs to increase their already exceptionally high profits," the statement said.

The contract between the International Longshoremen's Association and the United States Maritime Alliance, a group of carriers, employers and port associations, had expired at 12:00 AM, Eastern Time, at which point the ILA went on strike for the first time since 1977. Although the ILA had asked union members not to speak to media, it had issued a statement for distribution. "Due to corporate greed, employers refuse to compensate the ILA's members fairly," the statement said. "Over the last several years, the net revenues of these companies have grown astronomically from hundreds of millions to billions of dollar while the ILA members' wage increases do not even cover the cost of inflation." Automation is, along with wages, the other key issue behind the strike. The ILA is seeking a ban on automated cranes, gates and container-moving trucks. "Employers push automation under the guise of safety, but it is really about cutting labor costs to increase their already exceptionally high profits," the statement said. The strike could cost the United States economy , according to experts, as well as disrupting the trucking industry, creating supply chain issues for manufacturers, and sending grocery prices back up even as progress has been made on inflation. The signs at the picket--"ILA workers over machines"; "Fight automation. Save jobs"--reiterated the union's points. Several perched on a vintage Chevy sedan. name: Merrin Campaign
subject: Letter Writing Invite
body:
Good afternoon!

My name is Will Funk, the campaign manager for Derek Merrin, who is running for Congress in Ohio's 9th Congressional District. Derek is running to unseat 42 year incumbent Democrat Marcy Kaptur. Due to redistricting in 2021, Marcy holds one of only **five seats President Trump won in 2020, but is currently held by a Democrat.** Therefore, our race is **vital** to securing the House majority, thus ensuring that President Trump is able to effectively pass pivotal legislation **to save our country.** I was forwarded your contact by the Trump campaign and wanted to reach out to see if you wanted to get involved with Team Merrin **fighting for the future of our nation.**
**
**
We are currently organizing a letter writing campaign to swing voters in our district.**These are the voters that will decide the election.** We have all the stamps and materials ready for you if you are interested in assisting us with this, and Derek will be hosting a letter writing party at the Lucas County Republican Headquarters (1306 Kittle Road) next Monday, October 7th at 5:30 pm, **the day before early voting starts.** To RSVP, you can respond to this email ([info@derekmerrin.com](mailto:info@derekmerrin.com)) or call/text 419-231-1111. Also, we are doing weekly phone banks at the Lucas County Republican HQ, but you can phone bank from your home any time of day if that's more convenient. We are happy to help set you up in our system if you are interested. **Thank you again** for your support of Derek Merrin, President Trump, and the United States of America, and we look forward to seeing you soon!
**
**
Best regards,

Will Funk
Campaign Manager
Merrin for Congress

subject: Tim Walz Won Last Night - Now Let's Win Nov 5
body:
The VP debate was a huge success for the ticket. Now it is time to send MAGA home packing.
| | | | | |
---
**VP Debate Recap: Walz Delivers, Vance Dodges, and the Democratic Agenda Shines**
---
| [](https://click.nodemleftbehind.com/click/gpnv-2uy3ia-f7njig-kyd76rh7/)
---
| | | | folks, Last night's vice presidential debate was a clear victory for **Tim Walz and the Democratic ticket.** Walz came prepared with facts, policy insights, and a vision for America’s future, while JD Vance spent the night dodging direct questions and clinging to **outdated Trump rhetoric.** Let’s break down the key moments: One of the most striking moments was when Walz directly asked Vance if he believed Donald Trump lost the 2020 election. Vance **dodged the question** , shifting the conversation to censorship—a classic move. Instead of giving a straight answer, he danced around the truth, revealing a lack of accountability that has become all too common in the Republican Party. If Vance can’t even admit the truth about 2020, **how can we trust him with the future?** Vance falsely blamed undocumented immigrants for driving up housing costs. Walz, on the other hand, stood grounded in the facts. As studies show, immigrants make up just a tiny fraction of homebuyers (**0.1% of mortgages in 2023!**). Housing affordability is being driven by far more complex issues like **low inventory and pandemic-era trends**. Walz made it clear that Democrats are focused on real solutions—**not scapegoating vulnerable communities.** Vance claimed he never supported a national abortion ban—another falsehood. Walz reminded viewers that Vance previously stated he **“wanted abortion to be illegal nationally.”** Now, conveniently, Vance is deferring to Trump’s state-by-state approach. The Democratic ticket, in contrast, has been unwavering in its **commitment to protecting women’s reproductive rights**. When the conversation shifted to climate disasters, it was obvious Walz was in his comfort zone. He showcased the Democratic commitment to **tackling climate change head-on** , while Vance continued to deny the realities we face. Walz’s command of the issue further solidified his position as the VP candidate **ready to lead on the most pressing challenges of our time**. Vance tried to sell Trump’s economic policies as the pinnacle of take-home pay, but the data speaks differently. Under Biden, **real disposable income hit record highs in March 2021** and has been on a firm upswing. Walz highlighted this clear win for American families, while Vance failed to provide a compelling vision for how a return to Trump-era policies would benefit everyday Americans. This debate has made one thing clear: **the Democratic ticket, led by Tim Walz, is ready to build on the progress we've made and tackle the challenges ahead**. With Vance dodging questions, flip-flopping on issues, and pushing false narratives, it’s clear that a Trump-Vance administration would only take us backward. [**_Now it’s up to us to keep the momentum going. Let’s continue to mobilize, get the word out, and remind voters what’s at stake. The future of our country depends on it._**](https://click.nodemleftbehind.com/click/gpnv-2uy3ia-f7njih-kyd76rh8/) -No Dem Left Behind

**Did Our Current Congresswoman Comment on This Report?** Although my opponent sits on the House Judiciary Committee and the Sub Committee on Immigration and Citizenship, there is not a word from her on this report. Check her website.

| | Friend, Hurricane Helene has wreaked havoc across East Tennessee, bringing deadly floods, road closures, and school disruptions. Our community is hurting, and now is the time for us to do what we do best: band together and help our neighbors in need. Whether it’s donating supplies, offering a warm meal, or lending a hand, every bit helps. These are our friends, and they need us.
---
| | [| | |
---|---|---](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=3daa81e067414751a8b11f4752730349&_e=sB0nji7JUCx7W5seRZfBVGYvFawgxVoN1QX5Gf9KdMXM9k-ZOrsSypv55gIquKHYeQ6dlVgKAy-xocTnLJvkUhIUofR-5xM5O3VcoCS1EqKXho4bjNoUsQIXkLXTth6UwEl2KobrmKaJLCRq0xa9ku-VlfhL8-aZmYZAqJbtImoLfoE-D45blElSxaf9NTdf5gMdiAydkDXgQdSGQdxb1b1eyczrlh01t9mKe23TEn8%3D "Tim Burchett | Hurricane Relief")

* [The Salvation Army](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=3daa81e067414751a8b11f4752730349&_e=sB0nji7JUCx7W5seRZfBVF7Wb9qld12hu1QQmLALxPf3OjtnGZiyGxweVBUL3EYChNovnoQha0mst1WOF8XmyAzUjwKThZjMh2i16PqaIxdRr-fg51SuXBzs-6KhQSrmubiEZS_8o94vX_OmKg_SX7n61ei0cTANZqPId8ppwnV8q65P1nJuO_2j0aT5UjLDWXZBCVtMG_0j7-nIp76vUHaMHFJeBLvU5r7MbDABDmf8-4o0y0lOsaQmCQCdGgkdkvcy7THGJ3mFMdWsL41N8CwTvM3HLU-8Qz4A6ePw3A0-QtDVF-TzoOAo-52Zp18n8sbNbD16SRtNdVFDK1kIWRxyzJBjO5BZUVOAIXRt8DGsqmW9BtngbSNm8K_KNTKQ) is providing essential relief services to impacted communities, including meals and emotional support.

---
| |

| | Hi Peter, **Join Delegate Sam Rasoul and The Humanization Project, on October 3rd, at 6:30pm, at the Grandin Theatre for a special screening of the short film, "Calls from Home." ** This 30-minute film follows the weekly broadcast through prison walls that conveys messages between incarcerated Virginians and their family members and loved ones. While uplifting those impacted by mass incarceration, the film also exposes the problem of family separation in rural prisons and the systemic racism of rural mass incarceration. Following the film there will be a panel discussion with participants of the film and local leaders on the issue. **All are welcome!** Please share with anyone you think may be interested. name: Tim Kaine
subject: I’m debating my opponent tonight, but before I do, I want to talk to you about why I’m in this race and what I’m fighting for. Will you take 5 minutes to read this email?
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Kaine for Virginia
body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP44/1/88924/images/Kaine-2024-NEW-blue.png]
Friends,
Tonight I will take the stage at Norfolk State University to finally debate my opponent, self-proclaimed MAGA candidate Hung Cao. If you don’t have time to read the rest of this email, I’ll ask right now: Will you please pitch in $3, $5, or $10 ahead of tonight’s debate to support my re-election? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024]
Cao has been enthusiastically endorsed by Donald Trump and has the backing of folks like Ted Cruz and Newt Gingrich. Virginia Governor Glenn Youngkin constantly fundraises and campaigns for him.
My opponent and I are pretty different. He’s got an A rating from the NRA, I’ve got an F. I’ve got a 100% on the Planned Parenthood Action Fund Congressional Scorecard, he was previously endorsed by the National Right to Life Committee. He wants to release and compensate convicted insurrectionists, I think the January 6th attack on our Capitol was a horrific and unAmerican stain on our history.
But another difference is how we view Virginians. He called a Staunton newspaper “podunk,” claimed it would be “ridonkulous” for him to drive to Abingdon to discuss issues, supports a plan to forcibly relocate federal employees out of Northern Virginia, labeled all NATO employees “lazy,” and even compared women and doctors making hard reproductive decisions to Nazis. I respect Virginians, love traveling all over the Commonwealth to work with them, and believe in results, not insults .
There are just 34 days left in this race, and I’m going to use every single one to make sure every Virginia voter knows where I stand on the issues they care about, and what the stakes are in this election.
To do that, I’m going to need your help. The Trump-Vance campaign has made it clear they want to flip Virginia this year, and they’ve got boots on the ground here trying to make it happen — plus support from the National Republican Senatorial Committee — all of which makes it harder for us to communicate clearly with voters the way we need to.
Before I take the stage for tonight’s debate, will you pitch in any amount to help my campaign fight back and do the critical work of reaching, persuading, and turning out undecided voters? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024]
Thanks a lot. I’ll see you tonight!
-Tim Kaine

You can tune into the debate at 7:00 PM ET — it’ll be on your local TV channel if you’re here in Virginia ( click here for a list [https://www.wavy.com/news/politics/virginia-politics/virginia-senatorial-debate-at-nsu-october-2/] ), or you can stream it online at WAVY.com [https://www.wavy.com/] .

subject: We’ve got to be brutally honest here
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Gallego for Arizona
body:
We ran the numbers after our end-of-quarter deadline on Monday. We checked the numbers again, because it was a little tough to believe. The long and short of it is that we came short.
#

It’s not looking good, Peter.
We’ve got some bad news here, and we ask that you not share it widely.
We ran the numbers after our end-of-quarter deadline on Monday.
We checked the numbers again, because it was a little tough to believe. The long and short of it is that we came short in all three metrics: Number of donors, number of donations, and total dollars raised.
We’ve missed goals before, but not like this. And what really makes this time different is that we’ve only got a few weeks to make that gap up. Time is short.
But at the end of the day, this is the real problem:**We made media reservations based on what we anticipated raising last month, and our projections for these final weeks.** If we fell short in September, an official FEC month, that tells us our October projections are off, too.
What all of that means is that we have to seriously consider making cuts that will damage our ability to win this race.
Before we do, we have to make every effort at narrowing the gap. So, we’re coming to you.
