Rick Scott is 100% BOUGHT by Big Sugar. Ya no más.
| | |
---
Friend, I need to come clean —
I talk a lot about how important it is to reach my fundraising goals, [**_like my $500,000 goal before midnight tonight._**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/94105692/502529213/-2090042367?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk2109-fr-nd&recurring=1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDYvMS8xMDc1MjUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNTAzNmVkMTgtY2E4MC1lZjExLTg0NzQtNjA0NWJkYThhYWU5IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=L4W1z5SRsCx3ot4-pRoeQO189foxn3UIYlOCeLoMqj8=)** ** But it's not just to keep my ads on the air or the lights on at HQ. **Our ability to hit these goals are a vital measure of our strength to win on Election Day — and my unspeakably wealthy opponent, Rick Scott,_is_ watching us.**
But despite Rick Scott personally floating himself a cool **$14 MILLION** so far, he's not the only big spender seeking to drown me out of Florida's race.
Truth is, Rick's super PAC is also bankrolling his reelection bid, with _truly massive_ donations from corporate giants **— most notably, Big Sugar.**
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/94105693/502529214/1820369458?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk2109-fr-nd&recurring=1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDYvMS8xMDc1MjUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNTAzNmVkMTgtY2E4MC1lZjExLTg0NzQtNjA0NWJkYThhYWU5IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=L4W1z5SRsCx3ot4-pRoeQO189foxn3UIYlOCeLoMqj8=)
A major power player — _and polluter _— in Florida,** Big Sugar groups like U.S. Sugar and Florida Crystals have given Rick's PAC $775,000 this cycle to target me with attack ads, and keep my voice from reaching voters.**
_But_ _how do you think Scott earned such a sweet deal?_
While governor, he hit state water management boards — which worked to restore the Everglades — with a **$700 MILLION budget cut **— driving a spike in pollution entering Florida's fragile wetland ecosystems.
Then, he **REPEALED** a law requiring regular septic tank inspections. When they leaked, the sewage entered our waters, only worsening the issue.
Finally, he **ABOLISHED** the Department of Community Affairs, which protected Florida communities from dangerous, greed-driven corporate activities.
**And Big Sugar —** whose crop-burning methods pollute the air near Black and Hispanic communities, and whose fertilizer-laden runoff drove one of the biggest red tide events in recent Florida history**— was a big winner.**
While I fought in Congress to secure $200 million in federal funds to restore the Everglades,** Red Tide Rick's rollbacks lost over $1 BILLION in revenue between 2017-19, killed thousands of manatees, and left our shores stinking from the smell of countless rotting sea creatures. **
**In short, Rick Scott is 100% BOUGHT by Big Sugar — **and it should leave a bitter taste in the mouth of anyone who cares about the iconic natural beauty or the people that make our Sunshine State so special. _**Ya no más.**_
The only special interests I'm beholden to are those of working Florida families and grassroots donors like you, who power my campaign for progress.
**But up against the double whammy of a filthy-rich Republican and his even bigger industrial allies, I don't stand a chance of overcoming their cash without your support in this final stretch.**

Your support is critical to help my chances of retiring Red Tide Rick, protecting Florida's natural beauty, and fighting for its people over big polluters in the U.S. Senate.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/94105694/502529215/1820369458?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk2109-fr-nd&recurring=1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDYvMS8xMDc1MjUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNTAzNmVkMTgtY2E4MC1lZjExLTg0NzQtNjA0NWJkYThhYWU5IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=L4W1z5SRsCx3ot4-pRoeQO189foxn3UIYlOCeLoMqj8=)_**

_(Texas)_

I had an amazing time joining the Montgomery County Democrats for their celebration! I’m proud to celebrate the start of Hispanic Heritage Month, which runs through October 15th. Texas is stronger because of our diversity and the beautiful addition of Hispanic culture, contributions and cuisine.

Thank you to the Harris County Democratic Party for hosting such an amazing event. Together, we celebrated our accomplishments and honored the hard work of our precinct chairs and party leaders. I sat with the Cy Fair Democrats but loved seeing friends from the Cy-Tomball Club, Katy, Baytown, Montgomery County, and Houston! What an uplifting event!

Feeling grateful for the invite to join the Spring Democratic Club this month. Their group is motivated and will be knocking on doors from now until Election Day. This important work makes a big difference in voter turn out. When we do the work, we win!

Had a fantastic time at the Walker County Democrats Officers Meeting. | **Legislative Update**
It's crucial for voters in District 8 to stay informed about their representation and these important decisions.
In September 2024, my opponent, Morgan Luttrell, made several key votes on significant legislation. He voted _**no**_ on H.R. 9747, a clean Continuing Resolution (CR) that extended government funding until December 20, 2024, which passed 341-82. However, he supported H.R. 9494, a CR with Trump caveats that extended to March 25, 2025, which failed 202-220. He also voted *yes* on H.Res. 1469, pertaining to the Afghanistan withdrawal, and H.R. 3334, the Stop COP Act, sanctioning Chinese oppressors.
In September 2024, several key bipartisan bills passed in Congress. The Fix Our Forests Act (H.R. 8790) passed to improve forest management, and the Next Generation Pipelines Research & Development Act (H.R. 7073) advanced to support energy infrastructure innovation. DHS Cybersecurity On-the-Job Training (H.R. 3208) and the NASA Reauthorization Act (H.R. 8958) also passed, bolstering cybersecurity training and NASA's future. The House approved H.R. 9106 to enhance presidential security and H.R. 5717, which prevents bailouts for sanctuary cities. Additionally, the GUARDRAIL Act (H.R. 4790) passed, limiting securities disclosures, while H.R. 3724 promoted college accreditation excellence. The RETIRE Act (H.R. 5339) aimed at increasing retirement earnings by rolling back ESG investments, also passed. Congress further advanced the Autism Cares Act (H.R. 7213) and H.R. 8314, which restricts foreign election interference by limiting political donations from tax-exempt organizations receiving foreign funds. Luttrell voted _**yes**_ on all of these bills.
Other notable votes include my opponent’s support for H.R. 7980, which aims to end Chinese dominance in electric vehicles, and H.R. 9456, protecting American agriculture from foreign adversary investments. Lastly, Luttrell voted _**yes**_ on H.R. 1516, which restricts donations to higher education institutions from the Chinese government.

Together, we celebrated our accomplishments and honored the hard work of our precinct chairs and party leaders. I sat with the Cy Fair Democrats but loved seeing friends from the Cy-Tomball Club, Katy, Baytown, Montgomery County, and Houston! What an uplifting event! | | Young Democrats (Conroe, Texas) I was invited to speak at the Montgomery County Democrats meeting! It's inspiring to see the Young Democrats group growing in numbers and connecting with their communities. Proud to work alongside such motivated activists! | | | | | | | | | | | Spring Democrats (Spring, Texas) Feeling grateful for the invite to join the Spring Democratic Club this month. Their group is motivated and will be knocking on doors from now until Election Day. This important work makes a big difference in voter turn out. When we do the work, we win! | | Officers Meeting (Huntsville, Texas) Had a fantastic time at the Walker County Democrats Officers Meeting. This group is a powerhouse of positivity, working hard to register community members and students at Sam Houston State University. They’re out in their communities knocking on doors to educate voters and hosting social events to bring us all together. | | | | | | | | | | | Speaking at Blue Woods Meeting (Panorama Village, Texas) What a great evening speaking at the Blue Woods Dem group meeting in Montgomery County! Connecting with enthusiastic voters who genuinely care about their community and county was truly inspiring. The Montgomery County Dems are on the move! | | Cy-Fair Area Dems (Cypress, Texas) Feeling hopeful and inspired after the Cy-Fair Area Democratic Club meeting! It was awesome to see several community members attending for the first time, all ready to volunteer and get out the vote. This group is organized and truly getting the work done for the community! Let’s keep the momentum going! | | | Legislative Update It's crucial for voters in District 8 to stay informed about their representation and these important decisions. In September 2024, my opponent, Morgan Luttrell, made several key votes on significant legislation. He voted no on H.R. 9747, a clean Continuing Resolution (CR) that extended government funding until December 20, 2024, which passed 341-82. However, he supported H.R. 9494, a CR with Trump caveats that extended to March 25, 2025, which failed 202-220. He also voted yes on H.Res. 1469, pertaining to the Afghanistan withdrawal, and H.R. 3334, the Stop COP Act, sanctioning Chinese oppressors. In September 2024, several key bipartisan bills passed in Congress. The Fix Our Forests Act (H.R. 8790) passed to improve forest management, and the Next Generation Pipelines Research & Development Act (H.R. 7073) advanced to support energy infrastructure innovation. DHS Cybersecurity On-the-Job Training (H.R. 3208) and the NASA Reauthorization Act (H.R. 8958) also passed, bolstering cybersecurity training and NASA's future. The House approved H.R. 9106 to enhance presidential security and H.R. 5717, which prevents bailouts for sanctuary cities. Additionally, the GUARDRAIL Act (H.R. 4790) passed, limiting securities disclosures, while H.R. 3724 promoted college accreditation excellence. The RETIRE Act (H.R. 5339) aimed at increasing retirement earnings by rolling back ESG investments, also passed. Congress further advanced the Autism Cares Act (H.R. 7213) and H.R. 8314, which restricts foreign election interference by limiting political donations from tax-exempt organizations receiving foreign funds. Luttrell voted yes on all of these bills. Other notable votes include my opponent’s support for H.R. 7980, which aims to end Chinese dominance in electric vehicles, and H.R. 9456, protecting American agriculture from foreign adversary investments. Lastly, Luttrell voted yes** on H.R. 1516, which restricts donations to higher education institutions from the Chinese government. | Thank you so much for your continuous support.\- Laura Jones for Congress TX-8 | | | | | | | | | | | Copyright (C) 2024 Laura Jones for Congress. body:
When workers fight, we all win

| | | [ ](jillstein2024.com/)
---
Peter, At midnight on October 1st, tens of thousands of dock workers went on strike and shutdown ports from Maine to Texas to demand fair wages and no automation of their jobs. Stein/Ware stands in full solidarity with the International Longshore Association in their fight for fair wages and job security. When workers stand up for their worth it uplifts all working people.

---
[ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/ads?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=fundraising_10_2_am&n=1)
---
The corrupt duopoly of war and Wall Street have rigged the economy against workers. Over the past 50 years, real wages have stagnated while corporate profits have skyrocketed. Soaring inflation, fueled by corporate greed, has driven up the cost of living, far surpassing any modest wage gains working people have won. The Biden-Harris administration has tried to sell itself as pro-union, but their actions tell another story.

In December 2022, Biden signed legislation to break a rail workers strike, a move that garnered wide bi-partisan support, including self-described champion for the working class, Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez. The deal ultimately left rail workers without any paid sick leave, forcing workers to choose between their health and the paychecks they need to keep a roof over their heads.

Only three months later a catastrophic train derailment unleashed a toxic hell upon the small town of East Palestine, Ohio, the consequences of which will be felt for generations to come. The railroad bosses were given a green light by the Biden-Harris administration to reap huge profits at the expense of staffing and the repercussions were suffered not only by the rail workers themselves, but also by the entire town of East Palestine.

Jill and Butch will fight for all working people. Stein/Ware supports a $25 minimum wage, strengthening unions and abolishing “right to work for less” laws.

[_**We have just over a month to make sure that Americans everywhere know that they have a pro-worker, anti-genocide, climate emergency choice in Stein/Ware to vote for in November. Can you give generously today to help them get the word out at this critical moment?**_](https://www.jillstein2024.com/ads?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=fundraising_10_2_am&n=2)

---
Together we can create an economy that benefits all working people, instead of exploiting the sweat and sacrifice of labor to enrich the 1%.

Thank you for all you do to support this movement. We couldn’t do it without you. In solidarity and gratitude, Team Jill Stein and Butch Ware

subject: We Need Your Help! Canvass for Derek Tran with Celebrities – Oct. 12
body:
Good afternoon!

The election is just around the corner—less than 34 days away—and this race is incredibly close! With Michelle Steel pulling Elon Musk into the fight, we need to step up our game to ensure Derek Tran wins. If we want Kamala Harris and the administration to continue making real progress, securing a blue Congress is essential.

That’s why we’re asking you to join us on Saturday, October 12, from 9:30 AM to 1 PM PDT, for a special canvassing event with Derek Tran and some Hollywood VIPs. This is our chance to reach out to voters and show them why Derek is the leader we need.

No experience? No worries! We’ll provide all the training you need to get started. [Sign up to join us for the event here](https://mobilize.us/s/kb84Aw). If you can’t make this event, we have plenty of other opportunities listed on our [Mobilize Page](https://www.mobilize.us/derektranforcongress/?org_ids=38709). Every moment you contribute brings us one step closer to victory.

Event details will be sent closer to the date after you register. If you have any questions, feel free to contact me ([kayhan@cadem.org](mailto:kayhan@cadem.org)), Ethan ([etran@cadem.org](mailto:etran@cadem.org)), or Julia ([jthomas@cadem.org](mailto:jthomas@cadem.org)).

Your time and energy could make the difference. Let’s make sure we secure this seat!

Best wishes,

| This evening, our friends and neighbors of the Jewish faith, celebrate Rosh Hashanah. Typically a joyous occasion and the start of their new year, this year brings with it a grave situation.

We not only approach the 1 year anniversary of Hamas' attack that killed more than 1,000 people, but Israel is again under attack.

It is more important than ever that we stand in unwavering solidarity with the people of Israel and the Jewish faith. We must continue to work together to ensure that every person can live in peace, free from fear and hatred. Attacks on Israel are attacks on democracy and freedom, and we must not tolerate the rise of antisemitism in any form—at home or abroad.

As we enter this new year, let us renew our commitment to standing with our ally and supporting their right to exist. L’shanah tovah. May this New Year bring strength, safety, and peace for Israel and Jewish communities everywhere.

name: Kayhan Bakian
subject: We Need Your Help! Canvass for Derek Tran with Celebrities – Oct. 12
body:
Good afternoon!

The election is just around the corner—less than 34 days away—and this race is incredibly close! With Michelle Steel pulling Elon Musk into the fight, we need to step up our game to ensure Derek Tran wins. If we want Kamala Harris and the administration to continue making real progress, securing a blue Congress is essential.

That’s why we’re asking you to join us on Saturday, October 12, from 9:30 AM to 1 PM PDT, for a special canvassing event with Derek Tran and some Hollywood VIPs. This is our chance to reach out to voters and show them why Derek is the leader we need.

No experience? No worries! We’ll provide all the training you need to get started. [Sign up to join us for the event here](https://mobilize.us/s/kb84Aw). If you can’t make this event, we have plenty of other opportunities listed on our [Mobilize Page](https://www.mobilize.us/derektranforcongress/?org_ids=38709). Every moment you contribute brings us one step closer to victory.

Event details will be sent closer to the date after you register. If you have any questions, feel free to contact me ([kayhan@cadem.org](mailto:kayhan@cadem.org)), Ethan ([etran@cadem.org](mailto:etran@cadem.org)), or Julia ([jthomas@cadem.org](mailto:jthomas@cadem.org)).

Your time and energy could make the difference. Let’s make sure we secure this seat!

Best wishes,

**

Gratefully,
Susan

Derek,
As Rosh Hashanah begins this evening at sundown, I’ve been reflecting on what this holiday means to me.
I’ve thought about the lessons instilled in me by my parents while growing up and the sermons from rabbis over the years. The lessons that my faith taught me about miracles and believing in a brighter future — even when so much seems broken around us — continue to guide me to this day.
These principles have led me to pursue criminal justice reform, to make housing the homeless a key priority, to attack discrimination, to ensure the rule of law is applied equally, and to protect our democracy — a precious miracle that has never been in greater jeopardy.
It is because of my faith that I have not been discouraged when Trump and his cult of MAGA allies hurl attacks my way. Derek, I know that even in the face of these MAGA attempts to undermine the credibility of my oversight — from investigating and impeaching Donald Trump to managing his Senate trial to serving on the January 6 Committee — we can overcome their attacks, strengthen our democracy, and make the progress our country demands.
**[We have just over a month until Election Day. Last night's vice-presidential debate was a stark reminder of the critical choices facing our nation. JD Vance's unprincipled performance laid bare the risks of a second Trump administration.

On healthcare, Vance brazenly lied, claiming Trump protected Obamacare when _in reality he used every tool at his disposal to try and kill it throughout his presidency._
Now Vance is backing Trump’s “concept of a plan.” He has suggested failed high-risk health insurance pools that require those with pre-existing conditions to pay sky-high premiums.
**In the richest nation on Earth, our health should not be dictated by our bank account. But under a Trump administration, it would be.**

Last night I attended a VP Debate Watch Party in Potsdam, New York, at the St. Lawrence County Democratic Headquarters.
My Republican opponent, Republican Conference Chair Elise Stefanik, participated in a CBS "spin room" in New York City. Who's out of district now, Elise?
It is not unusual for Elise to miss opportunities to meet face-to-face with voters. For the past three years, Elise has been very busy building her brand on the national stage, while seeming to forget the constituents of New York's 21st Congressional District.
Spin, Stefanik, spin. Naturally, some of the topics of the debate intersected with remarks I have heard from voters when I am on the campaign trail.
Healthcare is a hot topic. Too many NY-21 families are paying record-high premiums, and have to meet insurmountable deductibles. Some voters have delayed going to the doctor because they can't afford the copay. Others tell me they have delayed expensive medical procedures because their doctor is not available, but then that procedure gets rolled over to a different year and they face another new deductible. Bottom line: on healthcare, we just can't seem to get ahead.
The Democrats, under Obama and now under Biden, have tirelessly sought to expand the Affordable Care Act and reduce out of pocket costs for everything from checkups to insulin prices. The Republicans, when Obama was in office and then continuing under Trump, have sued dozens of times over the Affordable Care Act, despite the fact that the Supreme Court upheld the ACA for the third time in 2021 in California v. Texas.
But wait. The healthcare issue is squarely on the shoulders of Elise Stefanik. As Republican Conference Leader, she decides - on a daily basis - what gets to the House floor for action and vote by Congress. If she wanted something changed about healthcare in this country, she is empowered to do so - not the Vice President, who cannot introduce a bill, and whose primary role in Congress is to cast a vote in the event of a tie in the Senate. Not Governor Tim Walz, who left Congress in 2019. And certainly not fairly-new Senator JD Vance, who missed the last 18 votes in the Senate.
Elise Stefanik, for the past three years as Republican Conference Leader, has been in a position to introduce legislation, harness the votes, and pass any healthcare plan she wanted - not a concept of a plan - an actual plan.
But she didn't. As a good and faithful foot soldier for MAGA-In-Chief Donald Trump, she kept the spin in Congress spinning on healthcare.
Stop the blame game, Elise, and do some of the work you are sent to Congress to do.
On immigration, the Stefanik Screech sounds off frequently. Let's review. The fact that we don't have a border policy is squarely on Stefanik's shoulders. Again, as Republican Conference Leader, Stefanik might have worked with her Republican colleagues in the Senate to push the bill through (reminder: JD Vance voted "Nay" on this bill), send it to the House, and approve the most sweeping immigration reform bill we've seen since the 1980s.
The bipartisan immigration bill that was up for consideration gave us more border agents and more immigration judges at the border to process applications. What our small business owners in upstate New York really need is a temporary work visa so they can hire new immigrants for their farms, small manufacturing businesses, hotels, and restaurants. This would be a win-win: new immigrants could support themselves and towns and counties would have more employees paying into the tax base.
Stefanik, as Republican Conference chair, had it well within her grasp to revive the immigration bill by reintroducing it in the House after it failed in the Senate. She did not. Instead, as a good and faithful foot soldier, she fell in line with Trump's desire to keep the immigration issue alive during the 2024 election cycle. A reminder to Elise Stefanik: these are human lives you're dealing with. "Pro life" means all life. Other reminder: immigration has direct impact on four of the fifteen counties in your district that are on the Canadian border.
Instead of doing the right thing, Stefanik chose Trump over NY-21 voters. And as a good and faithful foot soldier Stefanik continuously sounds off about Vice President Harris, whom she erroneously calls a "czar". Wrong country. It's the Russians who have czars, not the US. President Biden never designated a "border czar".
I'm going to Congress to restore honesty and integrity to our government. Former President Donald Trump was so lacking in honesty and integrity, he blackmailed Ukrainian Preseident Zelensky in order to tip the 2020 election in his favor. Then, when he did not win, Trump summoned his supporters to stage an insurrection on January 6, 2021 to disrupt the certification of the vote.
In last night's debate, JD Vance, in his "damning non-answer", could not even state that Trump lost the election.
Like JD Vance, my Republican opponent, Elise Stefanik, digs in on her lack of honesty and integrity by standing by Trump all the way. Stefanik calls the insurectionists "hostages". She overlooks the fact that Capitol Police officers were beaten and tortured on January 6. So much for her claim to "Back the Blue".
And it goes further. Stefanik, who at first supported aid to Ukraine in support of the heritage of many in her district (isn't the Stefanik heritage also Eastern European?), fell in line with Trump's bidding by voting no on the most recent aid to Ukraine package, thus endangering Ukraine and our NATO Allies. Stefanik chose Trump over Ukraine. Stefanik chose Trump over her New York voters.
Even with a win for the Dems, the likes of JD Vance, Josh Hawley, Marjorie Taylor Greene, Ted Cruz, and Elise Stefanik will disrupt any effort to advance the Opportunity Economy that Future President Kamala Harris may seek to implement.
I'm telling voters: a vote for Elise Stefanik is as devastating as a vote for Donald Trump.
I'm asking each of you to tell five NY-21 voters, who then tell five NY-21 voters, who then tell five NY-21 voters - you get the idea.
Remember: when Democrats vote, Democrats win.

clean_body: A vote for Elise Stefanik is as devastating as a vote for Donald Trump | | ---|---|--- | | | Forwarded this email? ? for more NY-21 Updates on the Congressional Race * A vote for Elise Stefanik is as devastating as a vote for Donald Trump | | | Oct 2 | | | | | | | | | | | | Last night I attended a VP Debate Watch Party in Potsdam, New York, at the St. Lawrence County Democratic Headquarters. My Republican opponent, Republican Conference Chair Elise Stefanik, participated in a CBS "spin room" in New York City. Who's out of district now, Elise? It is not unusual for Elise to miss opportunities to meet face-to-face with voters. For the past three years, Elise has been very busy building her brand on the national stage, while seeming to forget the constituents of New York's 21st Congressional District. Spin, Stefanik, spin. Naturally, some of the topics of the debate intersected with remarks I have heard from voters when I am on the campaign trail. Healthcare is a hot topic. Too many NY-21 families are paying record-high premiums, and have to meet insurmountable deductibles. Some voters have delayed going to the doctor because they can't afford the copay. Others tell me they have delayed expensive medical procedures because their doctor is not available, but then that procedure gets rolled over to a different year and they face another new deductible. Bottom line: on healthcare, we just can't seem to get ahead. The Democrats, under Obama and now under Biden, have tirelessly sought to expand the Affordable Care Act and reduce out of pocket costs for everything from checkups to insulin prices. The Republicans, when Obama was in office and then continuing under Trump, have sued dozens of times over the Affordable Care Act, despite the fact that the Supreme Court upheld the ACA for the third time in 2021 in California v. Texas. But wait. The healthcare issue is squarely on the shoulders of Elise Stefanik. As Republican Conference Leader, she decides - on a daily basis - what gets to the House floor for action and vote by Congress. If she wanted something changed about healthcare in this country, she is empowered to do so - not the Vice President, who cannot introduce a bill, and whose primary role in Congress is to cast a vote in the event of a tie in the Senate. Not Governor Tim Walz, who left Congress in 2019. And certainly not fairly-new Senator JD Vance, who missed the last 18 votes in the Senate. Elise Stefanik, for the past three years as Republican Conference Leader, has been in a position to introduce legislation, harness the votes, and pass any healthcare plan she wanted - not a concept of a plan - an actual plan. But she didn't. As a good and faithful foot soldier for MAGA-In-Chief Donald Trump, she kept the spin in Congress spinning on healthcare. Stop the blame game, Elise, and do some of the work you are sent to Congress to do. On immigration, the Stefanik Screech sounds off frequently. Let's review. The fact that we don't have a border policy is squarely on Stefanik's shoulders. Again, as Republican Conference Leader, Stefanik might have worked with her Republican colleagues in the Senate to push the bill through (reminder: JD Vance voted "Nay" on this bill), send it to the House, and approve the most sweeping immigration reform bill we've seen since the 1980s. The bipartisan immigration bill that was up for consideration gave us more border agents and more immigration judges at the border to process applications. What our small business owners in upstate New York really need is a temporary work visa so they can hire new immigrants for their farms, small manufacturing businesses, hotels, and restaurants. This would be a win-win: new immigrants could support themselves and towns and counties would have more employees paying into the tax base. Stefanik, as Republican Conference chair, had it well within her grasp to revive the immigration bill by reintroducing it in the House after it failed in the Senate. She did not. Instead, as a good and faithful foot soldier, she fell in line with Trump's desire to keep the immigration issue alive during the 2024 election cycle. A reminder to Elise Stefanik: these are human lives you're dealing with. "Pro life" means all life. Other reminder: immigration has direct impact on four of the fifteen counties in your district that are on the Canadian border. Instead of doing the right thing, Stefanik chose Trump over NY-21 voters. And as a good and faithful foot soldier Stefanik continuously sounds off about Vice President Harris, whom she erroneously calls a "czar". Wrong country. It's the Russians who have czars, not the US. President Biden never designated a "border czar". I'm going to Congress to restore honesty and integrity to our government. Former President Donald Trump was so lacking in honesty and integrity, he blackmailed Ukrainian Preseident Zelensky in order to tip the 2020 election in his favor. Then, when he did not win, Trump summoned his supporters to stage an insurrection on January 6, 2021 to disrupt the certification of the vote. In last night's debate, JD Vance, in his "damning non-answer", could not even state that Trump lost the election. Like JD Vance, my Republican opponent, Elise Stefanik, digs in on her lack of honesty and integrity by standing by Trump all the way. Stefanik calls the insurectionists "hostages". She overlooks the fact that Capitol Police officers were beaten and tortured on January 6. So much for her claim to "Back the Blue". And it goes further. Stefanik, who at first supported aid to Ukraine in support of the heritage of many in her district (isn't the Stefanik heritage also Eastern European?), fell in line with Trump's bidding by voting no on the most recent aid to Ukraine package, thus endangering Ukraine and our NATO Allies. Stefanik chose Trump over Ukraine. Stefanik chose Trump over her New York voters. Even with a win for the Dems, the likes of JD Vance, Josh Hawley, Marjorie Taylor Greene, Ted Cruz, and Elise Stefanik will disrupt any effort to advance the Opportunity Economy that Future President Kamala Harris may seek to implement. I'm telling voters: a vote for Elise Stefanik is as devastating as a vote for Donald Trump. I'm asking each of you to tell five NY-21 voters, who then tell five NY-21 voters, who then tell five NY-21 voters - you get the idea. Remember: when Democrats vote, Democrats win. (You can support my effort to unseat Stefanik by mailing a check to Paula Collins for Congress; 441 Old State Road; Dekalb Junction, NY 13630. You can also find me on ActBlue at . Thank you!) If we haven 't met yet, I am Paula Collins, the Democratic and Working Families Party Candidate for New York's 21st Congressional District. Your comments are invaluable to me. Please let me hear from you. Remember that you can always visit my website at www.paulacollinsforcongress.com or by sending me a text at 315-230-3920. | | | | | | | (C) 2024 Paula Collins 548 Market Street PMB 72296, San Francisco, CA 94104 ? ?

body:
JD Vance is a hypocrite
#

Team -
In case you missed it, during last night’s vice presidential debate, JD Vance said that the solution to school shootings is “stronger doors and windows” on our school buildings.
That’s it. He illustrated zero policy solutions. Just windows and doors.
JD offered empty platitudes on last night’s debate stage, insisting that he cares about ending our nation’s gun violence epidemic.
But Vance is a hypocrite. How can he claim that he wants to put an end to gun violence when he publicly opposes universal background checks and red flag laws?
The real reason for our nation’s gun violence crisis is not a lack of stronger doors and windows in our schools. It’s exactly what Tim Walz said last night:
**_“Sometimes, it’s just the guns.”_**
If JD Vance and Donald Trump are elected this November, they will be too busy sitting in the pocket of the gun lobby to take meaningful action to keep us safe from gun violence. Donald Trump has openly bragged that his first administration “did nothing” on guns. We can be sure we’d see another four years of inaction under a Trump-Vance administration.

Dear Peter,

We thought you may be interested to receive this conservative news alert from Illinois Review, the largest conservative media source in Illinois, and the only source in Illinois that has been shared by President Donald Trump.
Nervous Tim Walz says he’s “Friends with School Shooters” and a “Knucklehead” as JD Vance Dominates VP Debate Hours After Iran Attacks Israel (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/10/nervous-tim-walz-says-hes-friends-with-school-shooters-and-a-knucklehead-as-jd-vance-dominates-vp-debate-hours-after-iran-attacks-israel.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=c3fe49c2f5-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)

Minnesota Governor and Democratic vice presidential candidate Tim Walz speaks during the Vice Presidential debate in New York City, Oct. 1, 2024. (Angela Weiss/AFP via Getty Images)
By Illinois Review

On Tuesday, U.S. Sen. JD Vance and Minnesota Gov. Tim Walz squared off in the only vice presidential debate before November’s election – just hours after Iran launched over 180 missiles at Israel – as foreign policy, the economy and the border crisis dominated the evening.

Walz, who was visibly nervous and uncomfortable on stage, had a difficult time defending Harris’ record over the last three and a half years – especially her open border policies that have allowed tens of millions of migrants to enter our country illegally in addition to an influx of illegal firearms and fentanyl.
CLICK TO READ FULL ARTICLE (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/10/nervous-tim-walz-says-hes-friends-with-school-shooters-and-a-knucklehead-as-jd-vance-dominates-vp-debate-hours-after-iran-attacks-israel.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=c3fe49c2f5-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)
The Ohio Republican U.S. Senator, who brought his A-game to the debate, and appeared confident and knowledgeable of the issues, responded to Walz and the bias CBS moderators, saying,

“You both seem to be missing the fact that under Donald Trump’s leadership, no new global conflict happened. Everything Iran has done has been under Kamala’s leadership.”

And in one of the most poignant moments of the evening, Vance left Walz virtually speechless with a simple but polite comment in response to the constant barrage of attacks about Trump’s supposed failed leadership at home and abroad, saying,

“You’ve got a tough job here. You’ve got to pretend that Donald Trump didn’t deliver rising take home pay, which of course he did. You’ve got to pretend that Donald Trump didn’t deliver lower inflation, which of course he did. And then you’ve got to defend Kamala Harris’s atrocious economic record, which has made gas, groceries, and housing unaffordable for American citizens.”
CLICK TO READ FULL ARTICLE (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/10/nervous-tim-walz-says-hes-friends-with-school-shooters-and-a-knucklehead-as-jd-vance-dominates-vp-debate-hours-after-iran-attacks-israel.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=c3fe49c2f5-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)
Walz’ bad night continued as moderators confronted him about the lie that he was in Hong Kong in 1989 during Tiananmen when photo evidence proved that he was stateside. The exchange was awkward as the governor responded by saying that he’s a “knucklehead at times.”

The evening took a strange turn during a discussion about reducing gun violence in schools when Walz claimed that he has “become friends with school shooters,” prompting Andrew Pollack, a father who lost a child during the Parkland, Florida school shooting to reply on X with,

“My daughter was killed in the Parkland school shooting. It’s absolutely abhorrent that Tim Walz has befriended school shooters. Disqualifying.”

name: Seth Nelson, Evergreen
subject: Channeling climate anxiety into action
disclaimer_text: paid for by Evergreen Action
body:
Resources for you to help those devastated by Helene
| | | | [](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/2913975/87SdQ4wZ) |
---|---|---
---
| Hi—

It's been a hard week, and our hearts are going out to everyone affected by Hurricane Helene.

It's hard to watch the news and grapple with the devastation we're seeing across the Southeast, where I grew up. Hurricane Helene has left at least 140 people dead and over 2 million people without power or access to safe drinking water. This tragedy feels deeply personal, seeing videos of small towns near where I lived swept away by catastrophic flooding. After surviving a deadly tornado outbreak more than a decade ago in Alabama—another place I've called home—the scenes are painfully familiar: entire communities destroyed, lives turned upside down. In the midst of this devastation, a harsh reality is clear: **climate change is no longer a distant threat, and no place is immune to its effects.**

Thankfully, in some areas, people were able to evacuate and get to safety before the worst hit—and that's because of NOAA, the government agency that houses the National Weather Service.

Trump's Project 2025 wants to dismantle NOAA, **which would make it harder for people to prepare for the very climate disasters his policies exacerbate.**

Unlike Trump, Kamala Harris knows that climate change is real and costly, which is why we must do everything we can to elect her so we can secure a safer climate future for ourselves and our loved ones. **A good start is to**[**make sure you're registered to vote.**](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/2913976/87SdQ4wZ)**
**
And if you're looking for ways to help hurricane relief efforts directly on the ground,**here are a few organizations and mutual aid funds that you can donate to:** |
---
|
* [Organizing Resilience Hurricane Relief Response Fund](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/2913977/87SdQ4wZ)
* [NC Foundation for Public School Children Disaster Relief Fund](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/2913978/87SdQ4wZ)
* [North Carolina Disaster Relief Fund](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/2913979/87SdQ4wZ)
* [Raleigh United Mutual Aid Fund](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/2913980/87SdQ4wZ)
* [Hurricane Mutual Aid by Youth Climate Activists](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/2913981/87SdQ4wZ)
* [Convoy of Hope Crisis Relief Response Fund](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/2913982/87SdQ4wZ)

|
---
| The climate crisis is inflicting traumas small and large on each of us, and the physical and mental toll can make it very hard to assess where our energy is most needed. For our part, Evergreen commits to staying true to our mission to fight this crisis and to providing meaningful opportunities for you to make a difference.

Our movement is strong and growing, and thanks for doing what you can for Hurricane Helene survivors.

In community, |
---
| | |
---
### Seth Nelson
Deputy Communications Director
Evergreen Action

subject: Why I got into public service
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Upset The Setup PAC
body:
Peter, it’s Tammy Baldwin. I wanted to take this opportunity to tell you a little more about myself, why I ran for the U.S. Senate, and why our campaign in Wisconsin is so important.
**When I was a child, I was diagnosed with a serious illness and spent three months in the hospital.** When I got better, my grandparents, who raised me, began looking for an insurance policy that would cover me in the future.
But they couldn’t find such a policy because of my previous illness. Not from any insurer. Not at any price. They had to pay for my health care out of pocket — and they had to make enormous sacrifices to do so — all because I was a child labeled with those words: "pre-existing condition."
Peter, I got into public service because I saw my grandparents stay up late at night, worried sick that I would fall ill again and that they wouldn't be able to afford my care. No one should ever have to go through that.
**Like 133 million Americans, I know what it's like to have the label "pre-existing condition" attached to my care — and before the Affordable Care Act was passed, many of us could be denied coverage.**
Today, insurance companies can no longer discriminate against someone based on their pre-existing condition. I championed health reform and fought to allow young people to stay on their parent’s insurance plan up to age 26. These policy changes have led to millions more Americans getting the health insurance they need.
So, you can imagine my frustration whenever Republicans attack our health care or threaten protections for folks with pre-existing conditions — people like me. The GOP has spent years playing politics with people’s lives. And if Mitch McConnell and his Republican megadonors flip my seat in Wisconsin and take hold of the Senate majority next election, countless Americans could find themselves in a place where insurance companies, once again, write all the rules.
The people of Wisconsin did not send me to Washington to take people’s health care away, which is why I fought against Republican repeal efforts and why I will never back down. But I can’t defend the hard-fought progress we’ve made without your help, Peter.

clean_body: Peter, it’s Tammy Baldwin. I wanted to take this opportunity to tell you a little more about myself, why I ran for the U.S. Senate, and why our campaign in Wisconsin is so important. When I was a child, I was diagnosed with a serious illness and spent three months in the hospital. When I got better, my grandparents, who raised me, began looking for an insurance policy that would cover me in the future. But they couldn’t find such a policy because of my previous illness. Not from any insurer. Not at any price. They had to pay for my health care out of pocket — and they had to make enormous sacrifices to do so — all because I was a child labeled with those words: "pre-existing condition." Peter, I got into public service because I saw my grandparents stay up late at night, worried sick that I would fall ill again and that they wouldn't be able to afford my care. No one should ever have to go through that. Like 133 million Americans, I know what it's like to have the label "pre-existing condition" attached to my care — and before the Affordable Care Act was passed, many of us could be denied coverage. Today, insurance companies can no longer discriminate against someone based on their pre-existing condition. I championed health reform and fought to allow young people to stay on their parent’s insurance plan up to age 26. These policy changes have led to millions more Americans getting the health insurance they need. So, you can imagine my frustration whenever Republicans attack our health care or threaten protections for folks with pre-existing conditions — people like me. The GOP has spent years playing politics with people’s lives. And if Mitch McConnell and his Republican megadonors flip my seat in Wisconsin and take hold of the Senate majority next election, countless Americans could find themselves in a place where insurance companies, once again, write all the rules. The people of Wisconsin did not send me to Washington to take people’s health care away, which is why I fought against Republican repeal efforts and why I will never back down. But I can’t defend the hard-fought progress we’ve made without your help, Peter. = If you've stored your info with ActBlue Express, we'll process your contribution instantly: = = = = = = I am not going to let anyone make me forget where I came from or why I got into public service in the first place. My experience has always inspired my work to do everything I can to make sure that every American has quality, affordable health care coverage and stand up against those who want to take it away. So long as you're with me, I know we can overcome any challenge we may face on the road ahead and stop the Republicans from taking away health insurance from millions of Americans once and for all. = Thank you for standing with me. — Tammy | | Paid for by Upset The Setup PAC (www.upsetsetup.org) Not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee. 600 Pennsylvania Ave. SE #15180, Washington, DC 20003 Upset The Setup is working everyday to elect young, diverse, progressive Democrats to critical local offices so we can build up our communities, increase opportunity, and eliminate poverty. subject: We met our goal!

body:
I’m happy to report that thanks to your support, we met our goal.
# [](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/892?refcode=em20241002-4356-footer&t=1&akid=4356%2E420207%2EADkau3)
Thank you, thank you, thank you, Peter!
If you've read any of our campaign emails lately, you know we've been working hard to reach an important end-of-quarter fundraising goal. The big deadline was Monday, and I'm happy to report that with your support, we met our goal.
The amount of time most elected officials spend on raising money is really disheartening. I’m so glad to know that grassroots supporters like you have my back so that I can do this work _without_ corporate PACs.
We’re a people-powered movement, and it shows in our average online donation of just $39. Everyday people who pitch in what they can, when they can are the fuel that powers our movement, and it’s going to be thanks to you that we elect Kamala Harris, Tim Walz, and Democrats across the country this November.
But we still have just over a month to go until Election Day, and there’s more work to be done. My campaign is organizing here in Seattle _and_ in swing states across the country. We’re even doing twice weekly phone banks with the Harris campaign to help get out the vote, because every single one is going to matter this year.
So thank you again, Peter — we couldn’t do this without you. Now let’s finish strong.
Pramila Jayapal

disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY THE NATIONAL REDISTRICTING ACTION FUND
body:
How you can help relief efforts in North Carolina, Tennessee, and across the South.
|
---

Peter,
Like so many of us, I watched the coverage and followed my friends' and loved ones' posts on social media in horror as the destruction of Hurricane Helene unfolded.
I was beyond relieved to hear that my siblings, nieces and nephews, along with their homes, were safe in western North Carolina.
**But Peter, so many were not as fortunate.**
Entire towns and sections of towns that I grew up with have been swept away.
_People are still waiting to be evacuated in their secluded mountain residences with no electricity, cell service, or potable water._
_Families are struggling to find groceries to feed their kids, and basic supplies are already dwindling._
**And the devastation extends far beyond my home state of North Carolina.**
**That’s why today, we’re asking you to support frontline organizations that are working around the clock to help the thousands of people impacted by the flooding. Can you make a $15 contribution today to help relief efforts? Here are some national and state-based organizations that could use your help today →**

clean_body: How you can help relief efforts in North Carolina, Tennessee, and across the South. | Peter, Like so many of us, I watched the coverage and followed my friends' and loved ones' posts on social media in horror as the destruction of Hurricane Helene unfolded. I was beyond relieved to hear that my siblings, nieces and nephews, along with their homes, were safe in western North Carolina. But Peter, so many were not as fortunate. Entire towns and sections of towns that I grew up with have been swept away. People are still waiting to be evacuated in their secluded mountain residences with no electricity, cell service, or potable water. Families are struggling to find groceries to feed their kids, and basic supplies are already dwindling. And the devastation extends far beyond my home state of North Carolina. That’s why today, we’re asking you to support frontline organizations that are working around the clock to help the thousands of people impacted by the flooding. Can you make a $15 contribution today to help relief efforts? Here are some national and state-based organizations that could use your help today → Our thoughts are with those who have lost their homes, livelihoods, or loved ones during this disaster. This is Rep. Byron Donalds, President Trump’s strongest supporter in Congress.
I went on the liberal podcast ‘The Breakfast Club’ where a guest tried to gaslight me - she said I should be thanking Kamala Harris for fixing our economy.
**This could not be further from the truth** \- Kamala Harris brought us massive inflation that we haven’t seen in a generation.
She cast the tie-breaking vote for Joe Biden’s 1.9 trillion dollar ‘American Rescue Plan.’
All the experts agreed this bill would destroy our economy - unfortunately, they were right. Now our communities are suffering.
I made my point, but my goal isn’t to argue with liberal podcasters - my goal is to ensure a Republican Majority in 2025.
Democrats are _**outraising**_ us by hundreds of millions. They’ve never been more primed to steal our House Majority and hold the White House. Unless we act now, we can never reelect President Trump and stop the mess the Democrats made of our country.
If we’re going to win, **we need all hands on deck**. That means every America-First Patriot to be giving 110% towards a complete and total victory in November.
_**[I’m humbly asking if you can chip in and help us hold the line. Any little bit helps.](https://link.support.byrondonalds.)**_

** _You are my pride and joy, Michigan._**

It’s Mike Rogers.

name: Neil Parrott
subject: Check out My New Commercial
body:
After the shocking lies about Neil's record, he responds. | | | [View this email in your browser](https://us2.campaign-archive.com/?e=5a45ee1154&u=fac7efbc0801875f99034b204&id=0907104fad)
---
|
---
| | Peter,

Please take a look at my second commercial that was just released.

My wife April and I made the decision long ago to never slander an opponent, but to tell the truth and use facts. My opponent has now broadcast several horrific lies about me, fully distorting my voting record as a State Delegate for 12 years.

My new commercial begins, "My opponent can't run on her record, so she's making up stories about mine."

Click on the link below to watch the 30-second commercial, then please consider what you could contribute to keep this ad on the air and to expand its reach.
---
| [CLICK HERE TO WATCH MY LATEST AD](https://mdpetitions.us2.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fac7efbc0801875f99034b204&id=1a5827e51b&e=5a45ee1154 "CLICK HERE TO WATCH MY LATEST AD")
---
| Now is not the time to sit back. This race could decide who controls the House, and I'm fighting hard for you.

I'm proud of my 12-year record as a Maryland State Delegate. I didn't play "party politics," I didn't phone it in - I took my responsibility very seriously. I reviewed every bill to see how it would impact YOU and your family.

To have that record twisted and slandered is disappointing, and frankly makes me a little mad. Maybe you've seen the slander. Maybe you have neighbors who have seen it and are unsure.

Please share this commercial with them.
---
| [CLICK HERE TO WATCH MY LATEST AD](https://mdpetitions.us2.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fac7efbc0801875f99034b204&id=a826665036&e=5a45ee1154 "CLICK HERE TO WATCH MY LATEST AD")
---
| [DONATE TO KEEP THIS COMMERCIAL ON THE AIR](https://mdpetitions.us2.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fac7efbc0801875f99034b204&id=a63d110996&e=5a45ee1154 "DONATE TO KEEP THIS COMMERCIAL ON THE AIR")
---
| I am an engineer, a small business owner, and a father of 3. I have invested in my community, and I love our country. I live right in the middle of District 6. I'm running to represent my friends and neighbors.

My opponent? Facts only:
* She has to drive 20 minutes to enter the District that she is running to represent.
* She cannot vote for herself, but has to vote in District 8 for the extreme-left Democrat, Congressman Raskin.
* She lives in Potomac, MD, right outside of DC in what can only be described as a mansion. It is very safe to say that she doesn't have to worry about the cost of gas, groceries, or rising interest rates.
* She was appointed by President Biden to work in his Commerce Department - The same department that counted illegal immigrants in the 2020 census.
* She was endorsed by Nancy Pelosi.

Our country has some SERIOUS problems caused by the Biden Administration and DC-Insiders like Nancy Pelosi... and my opponent, April Delaney, has been part of the problem. That is not slander, that is not a lie. That is just a fact.

---
| [CLICK HERE TO WATCH MY LATEST AD](https://mdpetitions.us2.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fac7efbc0801875f99034b204&id=462d8912d0&e=5a45ee1154 "CLICK HERE TO WATCH MY LATEST AD")
---
| [DONATE TO KEEP THIS COMMERCIAL ON THE AIR](https://mdpetitions.us2.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fac7efbc0801875f99034b204&id=456b3d7431&e=5a45ee1154 "DONATE TO KEEP THIS COMMERCIAL ON THE AIR")
---
| If you are anywhere near Frederick County, please drive to Walkersville on Thursday night, October 3, from 6:30-8pm to talk with me. If we haven't met yet, I would love that. If cost is an issue, please email us to work something out - we would love to see you there.

April will be baking some of her famous pies, but we'll have lots of pie for everyone.

You'll have a chance to meet Governor Ehrlich who will talk about his experiences on the campaign trail in Pennsylvania and about his new book, _142 Ways America Went from Sweet Land of Liberty to Weak, Woke, and Wobbly: A Reference Guide to the Biden Years._ Sounds interesting, right?

The next month will be hectic, but good. If you can join me Thursday night, please do. It will be worth the drive, and I'd love to talk with you.

For our Country,
Neil

body:
| I’ve spent my life in Southeast Wisconsin, and I’ve spent my career in service to it. _Tammy Baldwin here — I wanted to make sure you saw this message from Peter Barca. Peter is running for Congress in Wisconsin's 1st District, so I hope you'll read his update and[chip in if you can.](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/2155?c0=tbe-em-barca.YJN2VY&refcode=AU_STB_FR_TAN_GEN_AC_20241002_PM1_V1_S1&t=3&akid=3929%2E35263%2EJ15snA)_
* * *
[](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/2533?c0=tbe-em-barca.f9Z-zt&refcode=AU_STB_FR_TAN_GEN_AC_20241002_PM1_V1_S1&t=4&akid=3929%2E35263%2EJ15snA) Peter, my name is Peter Barca, and I’m the Democrat running to defeat Bryan Steil in Southeast Wisconsin. All I need you to know right now is that I’m in this race for you and your family. **I’ve spent my life in Southeast Wisconsin, and I’ve spent my career in service to it.** I don’t mean just politically, either. I’ve been an educator and a small business owner right here in Kenosha, too. **[Before I get into why this matters, can I trouble you for just $10 to support Tammy Baldwin and my campaign today? We’re up against all the might of National Republicans, and we can’t waste an opportunity to build our grassroots base >>](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/2533?c0=tbe-em-barca.f9Z-zt&refcode=AU_STB_FR_TAN_GEN_AC_20241002_PM1_V1_S1&t=5&akid=3929%2E35263%2EJ15snA)** | | [CHIP IN $10](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/2533?c0=tbe-em-barca.f9Z-zt&refcode=AU_STB_FR_TAN_GEN_AC_20241002_PM1_V1_S1&t=6&akid=3929%2E35263%2EJ15snA)
---
**My Republican opponent Bryan Steil has had an opportunity to serve Southeast Wisconsin as a Representative in Congress,_an incredible honor,_ and he has shown us time and again where his loyalties lie: with his party.**
Here’s one example: he voted for what Republicans called the _Limit, Save, and Grow Act of 2023_ , legislation that, if it had passed, would have slashed veteran benefits and limited access to Medicare, Social Security, and food assistance for those who need it most.

**Let's be clear, Peter: a "minimum national standard" IS a national abortion ban.**

JD Vance will continue to downplay and obfuscate his extremist views on abortion, but we know the truth: a Trump-Vance administration will do _everything in its power_ to strip away our rights and bodily autonomy. | | Dear Co-Laborer for Christ,

At Global Christian Relief (GCR), we stand united with Christian brothers and sisters in the world's most hostile territories, where the underground church cries out urgently: **_"Please, we need Bibles!"_**

We tirelessly print and distribute Bibles in these challenging regions. Brave believers risk their lives to smuggle Scriptures into secret house churches, underground networks, and communities of converts from Islam.

**_Today, I 'm writing to ask for your help in continuing this eternity-shaping mission_** -- and I want to show you just how powerful your support can be by telling you the story of an amazing woman named Suzanne.

[ ](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=6974e5b3eaba48b8aa94f8effcc72b7f&_e=XO27ZdEXAKQ8NDhsiPezoRxdEt30Co2mLMHIs-JCEYgtTRnwF0Qp4etwrMIBBBaoa0qbMo-gA8wz3Cwy1HMS7WjdXoxogteF_N6DCFDA_655u9YRMbQ-XDI8rM1vVOplyXPHOBneglARnuOHFLynrE_7geT3BHUWvnlplYQOUOtI1iEY82mf18T4TnzxLwT57ARFqIU6Hk7mc5zNQ7yKwnWwLhti5L8X4bIBzTFrw7x7EXaKPg0f6JrXWtNFhVFrCqj56sLoX17w6137gnbnYVL0okDWblS11Q_8CXlpQUdVCjdBlCwjdLKhbHSBSRQpegGqjr2adyS921gDAp17J726UuizzZ3DodQkfPDOmfrvAXay0a8OzJTfaxcwqNiVgOJvoa28tmQWn6uDXtDYwWyGBVyjD8g8ryAMd52B8FqJ1gC5o1wR1SqSh45y0rNz)

| | Suzanne, a persecuted Nigerian Christian, was tending a field with her father when violent Islamic extremists known as Boko Haram attacked. For three hours Suzanne had a gun forcefully held against her head as she refused to surrender to the terrorists.

Ultimately, Suzanne's persecutor pulled the trigger and shot Suzanne through the head, leaving her for dead. By God's grace, she survived, losing her eyesight

Here's the remarkable miracle of her story though . . .

Suzanne has taken the truths she found in God's Word and has put them into practice among her people. Today, she offers her persecutors forgiveness and an open invitation to her heavenly Father who can truly offer eternal forgiveness of sins.

This is the supernatural reconciling power of God's Word on full display!

But here's the truth _right now._ There are so many more Christians like Suzanne living in hostile countries and hungering for the "true bread" of God's Word for their spiritual nourishment (John 6:32).

**These regions are in the grip of terrorism and oppressive regimes seeking to erase all traces of Christianity.**

But in the midst of this great darkness, Scripture becomes a beacon of hope--the bread of life --for those enduring persecution. It is the source of strength and comfort for believers navigating the storm of oppression -- just like Suzanne.

**_Your compassionate support today empowers our teams to deliver Bibles where needed most_** -- even into communities like Suzanne's. From Iran to Pakistan, Iraq to Nepal, and Mozambique, persecuted believers, especially converts from Islam, hunger for the Word of God in their language.

Providing access to God's Word can make the difference between a believer standing firm or wavering in faith. [**_And today, for a gift of $50, you can deliver TEN Bibles to people desperate for truth --enough to supply an entire house church in some cases!_**](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=6974e5b3eaba48b8aa94f8effcc72b7f&_e=XO27ZdEXAKQ8NDhsiPezoRxdEt30Co2mLMHIs-JCEYgtTRnwF0Qp4etwrMIBBBaoa0qbMo-gA8wz3Cwy1HMS7WjdXoxogteF_N6DCFDA_655u9YRMbQ-XDI8rM1vVOplyXPHOBneglARnuOHFLynrE_7geT3BHUWvnlplYQOUOtI1iEY82mf18T4TnzxLwT57ARFqIU6Hk7mc5zNQ7yKwnWwLhti5L8X4bIBzTFrw7x7EXaKPg0f6JrXWtNFhVFrCqj56sLoX17w6137gnbnYVL0okDWblS11Q_8CXlpQUc9rsODwOahS9DnYpdxXnPH0Pu8lLoJtJwZrMxXapfL3KOVHPcWQKqtAZ263BsHc2RToBLG0o4s0xPoDNJPhPHkiVbjaUJpL-DqoGQisUcG39azKzDx2kPn0qVVTRgT1KX9LdCyejKCkFRxB-Tsy-oz)

The Apostle Paul assures us in Romans chapter 10 that "faith comes through hearing, and hearing through the word of Christ." That means that your gift is an eternal investment in the lives of those who dare to hope amidst persecution.

Every Bible received is a beacon of hope, cherished and proclaimed with unwavering faith, even amidst persecution. Through Global Christian Relief (GCR), you support a network of underground believers--your brothers and sisters--engaged in Kingdom work against all odds.

**The urgency of this mission cannot be overstated. Every Bible smuggled into these dark places is a miracle in itself. But we need many more miracles!**

Will you stand with us in this vital work by making a special gift today to provide God's Word to our suffering brothers and sisters in Christ?

**If so, here is a link where you can provide Bibles to the persecuted:[https://give.globalchristianrelief.org](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=6974e5b3eaba48b8aa94f8effcc72b7f&_e=XO27ZdEXAKQ8NDhsiPezoRxdEt30Co2mLMHIs-JCEYgtTRnwF0Qp4etwrMIBBBaoa0qbMo-gA8wz3Cwy1HMS7WjdXoxogteF_N6DCFDA_655u9YRMbQ-XDI8rM1vVOplyXPHOBneglARnuOHFLynrE_7geT3BHUWvnlplYQOUOtI1iEY82mf18T4TnzxLwT57ARFqIU6Hk7mc5zNQ7yKwnWwLhti5L8X4bIBzTFrw7x7EXaKPg0f6JrXWtNFhVFrCqj56sLoX17w6137gnbnYVL0okDWblS11Q_8CXlpQUckIpinI-TKT00U5r3xJVT9AkWyDxoiLRV_IxAa0P0qk7jqvkEdwzCeXF_dP0l-l8LT9q-0Zf9zz1XQYzvDKsCOHk1TwGer04-WYYzUbIlcAqiQdRXXiG6g5T7IrWUDX_N1Xx6pdC5ZHtFMTVNcpLft)**

GCR and our partners are committed to delivering as many Bibles as possible. But we cannot do it without your help!

Your gift of $50 delivers 10 Bibles for believers to study together. And a generous gift of $150 could bless a home church fellowship with 30 Bibles!

Whatever amount you can afford to give, I implore you not to delay. Our persecuted family in Christ is counting on us for access to "the words of eternal life" (John 6:68).

**Please make a generous gift of $50, $75, $100, or whatever you can possibly afford here at this link:[https://give.globalchristianrelief.org](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=6974e5b3eaba48b8aa94f8effcc72b7f&_e=XO27ZdEXAKQ8NDhsiPezoRxdEt30Co2mLMHIs-JCEYgtTRnwF0Qp4etwrMIBBBaoa0qbMo-gA8wz3Cwy1HMS7WjdXoxogteF_N6DCFDA_655u9YRMbQ-XDI8rM1vVOplyXPHOBneglARnuOHFLynrE_7geT3BHUWvnlplYQOUOtI1iEY82mf18T4TnzxLwT57ARFqIU6Hk7mc5zNQ7yKwnWwLhti5L8X4bIBzTFrw7x7EXaKPg0f6JrXWtNFhVFrCqj56sLoX17w6137gnbnYVL0okDWblS11Q_8CXlpQUcRZRXJh99ZFwRNIPnYbXR2M4hy50yWXfLn2-aLNLPhy0yyl4mSg46_kP8L2Ns_HOLd2sFfL2JYHt71XT9gI0Cj1tGgj7zB7ZjXEpg40GHm_Qq44flzCpGZldD725idK0k68Y9v4HL4w1Mm106Au-P3)**

Grateful for you.

Serving Christ,
Dr. David Curry

body:
| | | [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/94123152/502575930/131722189?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjIyMDNkN2MxLWRmODAtZWYxMS04NDc0LTYwNDViZGE4YWFlOSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=auy9zkulr4ZjZK91GvxoWNdpCJvTeMpmkFmkUxsOcQ0=&emci=bb55850b-4080-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&emdi=2203d7c1-df80-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&ceid=2107230)Hi Peter, OLCV is officially announcing our endorsements for the 2024 General Election! [**See all 98 of our endorsements by clicking here.**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/94123154/502575932/131722189?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjIyMDNkN2MxLWRmODAtZWYxMS04NDc0LTYwNDViZGE4YWFlOSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=auy9zkulr4ZjZK91GvxoWNdpCJvTeMpmkFmkUxsOcQ0=&emci=bb55850b-4080-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&emdi=2203d7c1-df80-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&ceid=2107230) If you need to double check which district you are in so you’re ready to vote for your endorsed candidates, [check out the district map here](https://click.everyaction.com/k/94123155/502575933/1765198759?appid=fd070b56c975456ea2a25f7e3f4289d1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjIyMDNkN2MxLWRmODAtZWYxMS04NDc0LTYwNDViZGE4YWFlOSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=auy9zkulr4ZjZK91GvxoWNdpCJvTeMpmkFmkUxsOcQ0=&emci=bb55850b-4080-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&emdi=2203d7c1-df80-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&ceid=2107230)! We've endorsed 3 pro-climate candidates in statewide races. **Dan Rayfield for Attorney General:** Dan is a proven environmental champ, with a lifetime OLCV score of 95%, who wants to hold polluters accountable when they spoil our air and drinking water. **Tobias Read for Secretary of State:** Tobias is yet another strong candidate for the environment, who developed the plan to conserve the Elliott State Forest and created a plan to make Oregon's pension fund net zero carbon emissions by 2050. And **Elizabeth Steiner for State Treasurer:** Elizabeth has a lifetime OLCV score of 89%, chief sponsored the COAL Act to phase out coal investments, and supported over $100 million in climate investment in Oregon. We need a supermajority in the senate to help us pass the most climate-friendly, affordable, equitable, and safe transportation package that we can in 2025. We are just one seat shy of a pro-environment supermajority! We need to elect **Anthony Broadman for Senate District 27 (Bend)** , who has been a strong transportation advocate on the Bend City Council. We also need to **re-elect Senator Chris Gorsek for Senate District 25 (east Multnomah County)** , who is co-chair of the Joint Transportation Committee and has a 92% OLCV lifetime score. We are also just one seat shy of a pro-environment supermajority in the State House, so we are working hard to protect vulnerable allies and champs, and pick up at least one other seat. OLCV is actively supporting eight House candidates through door knocking and volunteer recruitment efforts:
* Re-elect Rep. Tom Andersen for House District 19 (south Salem)
* Elect Lesly Muñoz for House District 22 (Woodburn)
* Re-elect Rep. Courtney Neron for House District 26 (Sherwood/Wilsonville)
* Elect April Dobson for House District 39 (Happy Valley)
* Re-elect Rep. Hoa Nguyen for House District 48 (Damascus)
* Re-elect Rep. Zach Hudson for House District 49 (Troutdale)
* Re-elect Rep. Ricki Ruiz for House District 50 (Gresham)
* Re-elect Rep. Emerson Levy for House District 53 (Redmond)

As I’m sure you already know, the weeks leading up to the election are crucial. This is when we need your support if these pro-environment candidates are going to be elected, so we can see the change that we want for our climate. To get ready for election day, [make sure you are registered to vote by October 15th](https://click.everyaction.com/k/94123157/502575934/-153793422?lang=en&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjIyMDNkN2MxLWRmODAtZWYxMS04NDc0LTYwNDViZGE4YWFlOSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=auy9zkulr4ZjZK91GvxoWNdpCJvTeMpmkFmkUxsOcQ0=&emci=bb55850b-4080-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&emdi=2203d7c1-df80-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&ceid=2107230)! To answer all your questions related to voting, check out our [Voter Resources here](https://click.everyaction.com/k/94123158/502575935/509024324?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjIyMDNkN2MxLWRmODAtZWYxMS04NDc0LTYwNDViZGE4YWFlOSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=auy9zkulr4ZjZK91GvxoWNdpCJvTeMpmkFmkUxsOcQ0=&emci=bb55850b-4080-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&emdi=2203d7c1-df80-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&ceid=2107230) and share it with your friends and family on social media. Be sure to tag us @olcv! Will you join us? [**You can help by signing up to volunteer with us and knock on some doors. **](https://click.everyaction.com/k/94123159/502575937/-600427321?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjIyMDNkN2MxLWRmODAtZWYxMS04NDc0LTYwNDViZGE4YWFlOSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=auy9zkulr4ZjZK91GvxoWNdpCJvTeMpmkFmkUxsOcQ0=&emci=bb55850b-4080-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&emdi=2203d7c1-df80-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&ceid=2107230) Sincerely,

clean_body: | | | Peter, OLCV is officially announcing our endorsements for the 2024 General Election! If you need to double check which district you are in so you’re ready to vote for your endorsed candidates, ! We've endorsed 3 pro-climate candidates in statewide races. Dan Rayfield for Attorney General: Dan is a proven environmental champ, with a lifetime OLCV score of 95%, who wants to hold polluters accountable when they spoil our air and drinking water. Tobias Read for Secretary of State: Tobias is yet another strong candidate for the environment, who developed the plan to conserve the Elliott State Forest and created a plan to make Oregon's pension fund net zero carbon emissions by 2050. And Elizabeth Steiner for State Treasurer: Elizabeth has a lifetime OLCV score of 89%, chief sponsored the COAL Act to phase out coal investments, and supported over $100 million in climate investment in Oregon. We need a supermajority in the senate to help us pass the most climate-friendly, affordable, equitable, and safe transportation package that we can in 2025. We are just one seat shy of a pro-environment supermajority! We need to elect Anthony Broadman for Senate District 27 (Bend) , who has been a strong transportation advocate on the Bend City Council. We also need to re-elect Senator Chris Gorsek for Senate District 25 (east Multnomah County) , who is co-chair of the Joint Transportation Committee and has a 92% OLCV lifetime score. We are also just one seat shy of a pro-environment supermajority in the State House, so we are working hard to protect vulnerable allies and champs, and pick up at least one other seat. Tom Andersen for House District 19 (south Salem) Elect Lesly Muñoz for House District 22 (Woodburn) Re-elect Rep. Hi Peter,

I just wanted to drop a quick **thank you** note to you for helping me hit our last FEC quarterly fundraising deadline before Election Day!

We had an _amazingly_ strong finish to the quarter, and we’re in a great position heading into the final month of the campaign.

We’re now turning our attention immediately to the start of mail-in voting in less than a week. We need to treat this as the start of the election, as ballots cast by mail could be the decider in this extremely close race.

I would say the Democrats should be embarrassed that we’ve been able to put a presumed “safe blue seat” in play, but this is more about the strength of our campaign thanks to supporters like you.

New Mexicans are **fed up** with Martin Heinrich’s and Kamala Harris’s failed and absent leadership, and we’re seeing the results in the polls.

That’s why I need to ask you to continue sending your support as we fight tooth and nail this final month. **We can’t let off the gas even a smidge.** We need to put our foot down.

[**Please consider chipping in $5 today to help us start October strong as well and keep taking the fight to Heinrich.**](http://links.nellanewmexico.com/u/click?_t=bec4f693b6284a4ba56cb04ba05e5b45&_m=9ee5cac4b3254cb4866bbe54c7939388&_e=_cZGHPGZY4NFUnAgbo6w9bgjZRcPSPv-JD1CG_blv2ixydiBdlSFaCneubRtsUW2K3e45qcYaV2e0H2qtkH-LL9rScOh3nziNhEjc3zza_HOdtCFvvhVV3_Kf8d40hheTWYqNjDYTh3NAbWDZkv4YaG9AzK_AO06YiWQzwwjFpHfO5lsnJXLsvkHyHs3gdQ98e7TnHjbWryWercZXQaB2CASgbeTWJtwhFLqAY_dEveIQvISu5YJ_RauMyWA8R_F4khee8_FeyS5ipJPJlZ2TgYXUZSwV2NM7EWetXmUjJ7FBqMj4gR90A1_y6__OHbD2PeqIAMgdwqsJd5sS0bAjd5cba1TOdXgHz6Fbzw64RdwSY0khBJntoZi7JRnbPbW)

**Nella Domenici**
Republican for Senate

| **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. **

She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. **

Team,

**Last night, J.D. Vance got one thing right: Even in his own state, a majority of voters oppose his extremist anti-choice stance on reproductive rights.**

But there was also a lot he _didn’t_ – or wouldn’t – say. He refused to say that Donald Trump lost the 2020 election. He rewrote the history of Trump’s many attempts to destroy the Affordable Care Act.

We know who J.D. Vance is. He’s the guy who said that the country is being run by “a bunch of childless cat ladies” and has pushed for higher taxes on people without kids to “punish the things that we think are bad.” He’s the guy who criticized Donald Trump for years and then joined his presidential ticket when it meant he could move ahead politically.

**He’s wrong for Wisconsin. And he’s wrong for our country.**

We need to keep him out of the White House – but we also need to elect a majority to Congress who will vote to codify reproductive rights and fight back against J.D. Vance’s pet policies.

Can I explain something, Peter?

I grew up in a twenty-four-by-thirty-six foot house. I lost three fingers on my left hand in a meat grinding accident when I was a kid. I am and always will be a farmer, like my folks and like my grandparents.

**In fact, I’m very proud to be the U.S. Senate’s only working dirt farmer.**

Every spring, I spend a lot of weeks working the stubble, getting equipment ready for planting, and out in the field seeding. Come summer, I am out there harvesting. I maintain my own heavy equipment and deliver my grain in a truck that’s a bit bigger than what any of my colleagues drive.

I buy grease by the case and seeds by the ton. I butcher my own beef. My wife, Sharla, and I work the farm hand-in-hand.

The task of scheduling my work in the Senate around the inflexible timing of farm responsibilities drives my staff crazy—but they know my farm work is non-negotiable. It keeps me, quite literally, grounded.

**And rather than spend my days hobnobbing with special interests, I rely on hard-working folks like you to power everything we do.**

[_**That’s why I’m personally asking you to join my reelection team and split $5 between Fight for Progress and my campaign today to help us defend Montana’s Senate seat.
