# Deadlines to register to vote online
Seventeen states have online voter registration deadlines next week. This is your last, last chance to have a say in the future of our country, in the rights and protections of you, your family, your communities, in driving policy on climate change, public health and social security.
**States with online voter registration deadlines next week (Oct 6 -- 12, 2024)**
* Sunday, Oct. 6: Alaska, Rhode Island, South Carolina
* Monday: Arizona, Florida, Georgia, Indiana, Kentucky, Louisiana, Ohio, Tennessee
* Tuesday: New Mexico
* Wednesday: Missouri
* Friday: Idaho, North Carolina, Oklahoma
* Saturday: Delaware

name: Kamala Harris
subject: Hurricane Helene
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Harris for President
body:
We will stand together for as long as it takes to recover and rebuild. | | |
---
Hello Peter, I wanted to devote some time today to address the impacts of Hurricane Helene. President Biden and I are working around the clock to support the people who were impacted by this horrendous storm. Our administration approved disaster declarations for several states prior to landfall. And we have coordinated a robust response in the days since -- deploying food, water, and generators, and working with the Federal Communications Commission and telecommunications companies on the ground to restore network services. I continue to receive operational updates from the FEMA Administrator Deanne Criswell. I have reached out to the governors of North Carolina, Georgia, and Florida, as well as other state and local officials. _I will travel down to Georgia today to meet with people in the affected communities,_ and to North Carolina once I know my visit will not impede emergency response operations. It is essential that we stand together for as long as it takes to recover and rebuild. clean_body: We will stand together for as long as it takes to recover and rebuild. | | | Hello Peter, I wanted to devote some time today to address the impacts of Hurricane Helene. President Biden and I are working around the clock to support the people who were impacted by this horrendous storm. Our administration approved disaster declarations for several states prior to landfall. And we have coordinated a robust response in the days since -- deploying food, water, and generators, and working with the Federal Communications Commission and telecommunications companies on the ground to restore network services. I continue to receive operational updates from the FEMA Administrator Deanne Criswell. I have reached out to the governors of North Carolina, Georgia, and Florida, as well as other state and local officials. I will travel down to Georgia today to meet with people in the affected communities, and to North Carolina once I know my visit will not impede emergency response operations. It is essential that we stand together for as long as it takes to recover and rebuild. At times of tragedy, we are reminded of how strong the bonds that unite us are, and it becomes even clearer that those seeking to divide us will not win the day. I hope you will join me and send your best wishes and your support. Thank you and take care, Kamala | | | | | | | | | | |

Listen, we can't stop these suppressive laws from going into effect -- at least to start. But we can draw attention to them, we can use them to organize and to turn out voters, and we can work to repeal these laws or fight them in court.
We must keep fighting these ploys to codify single-party power and control into state law. RUSH $25 or more right now to protect voting rights and make every vote count >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=100224_2&amount=25]

Democracy Docket: Louisiana Governor Signs Multiple Anti-Voter Bills and More Are Pending [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=100224_2&amount=25]
Louisiana's governor, Jeff Landry, has now signed eleven anti-voter bills into law in the last couple of weeks. He started the month off with these seven new suppressive laws:
➜ House Bill 285 requires the state secretary of state’s office to create an election integrity division to perform many duties, including “ conducting independent investigations into allegations of election irregularities .”
➜ House Bill 476 restricts people from delivering more than one absentee ballot via mail unless they are sending ballots on behalf of immediate family members.
➜ Senate Bill 155 only allows individuals to assist with more than one absentee ballot if they are helping immediate family members.
➜ Senate Bill 218 requires someone assisting a voter to provide their address and relationship to the voter and reveal if they were paid to assist.
➜ Senate Bill 226 requires that an absentee ballot that is missing information and is not fixed by the voter is considered a challenged ballot that is only counted if the majority of the election board decides it should be.
➜ Senate Bill 449 defines a qualified voter or elector as “ a person who has the proper qualifications provided by law to be entitled to vote and who is lawfully registered to vote .”
➜ Senate Bill 101 bans ranked-choice voting in Louisiana elections.
Every single one of these bills was passed with an eye on adding barriers to voting, reducing ballot access, and suppressing participation in Louisiana's elections. Opponents of voting rights are trying to codify their pathway to power in state law instead of winning elections fair and square.

As if that wasn't enough, he added these four new suppressive laws in the last few days :
➜ House Bill 506 requires individuals and entities to register with the Secretary of State before conducting voter registration drives. This is another attack on 3rd party voting rights groups like ours.
➜ House Bill 581 criminalizes being a witness on more than one absentee ballot for non-immediate family members and requires witnesses to provide their mailing address (another restriction on voter registration organizations).
➜ House Bill 114 creates new procedures for maintaining active voter lists and specifies conditions under which individuals can be purged from voter rolls, making it easier for the state to kick people off the list of registered voters.
➜ Senate Bill 436 requires individuals to provide proof of citizenship to register to vote despite no proof of non-citizens participating in elections in Louisiana or elsewhere across the country.
This is all a cynical, partisan ploy to suppress the vote and stay in power. It's the same playbook we've seen repeated by opponents of voting rights in states nationwide.

We are overwhelmed with gratitude. **From the bottom of our hearts, thank you for supporting the Center for Reproductive Rights.**

Thanks to your generous support, you met the $50,000 match goal we provided! Every single dollar you helped raise will go directly to defending, advancing, and protecting essential reproductive rights for millions.

**In today's challenging climate, the Center's work is more vital than ever. With relentless attacks on our basic reproductive freedoms, their work provides hope and action.** That's why we made this matching gift. If you’re like most conservatives, you get endless emails and text messages from candidates asking for money. _But how do you know if they are actually conservative and not just pretending?_ _How do you know if they even have a chance of winning?_ _How do you know if costly fundraising commissions and processing fees will consume most of your contribution?_ These are all important questions that everyone must ask if they want to be effective with their political contributions. **The Senate Conservatives Fund is one of the best ways to make your contributions count.** We do it by providing grassroots conservatives like you with a trusted list of candidates who are strong, viable conservatives. Every SCF-endorsed candidate must undergo a vetting process to help us determine whether they share our principles and values and, more importantly, will actually fight for them after the election. Every candidate must also run a professional campaign capable of winning. But creating a list of conservative candidates is just the beginning; we also give you an _**[_**effective way to fund their campaigns!**_](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=af15904fe91940d8b748103ca2119347&_e=6rUysTmjiUq1xZQqp-a2W7OMfRI4xhQ3GhQhIVE9PkUVYy94A2NpVW_VVLsQrHLA2IJaSaESy0zd7GNs97G-BcnIH_W_luNL-uBtk7nswiI6v0RQUpa_I03XeSp66rJad13PhFa2aay0-zcvj3-Ms-WjXe_TPHq91POGGUY10NEKbWayJ0cUjMW8iEjCokKdBXZ1KSudzOWZj4UjI8GDV-LtXlVOo6_M5qkpaQJa7rQ%3D)**_ The best way to support a candidate financially is to donate to their campaigns. Once you move away from the candidate’s campaign — whether it be a party committee, joint-fundraising committee, PAC, or other organization — your contribution's effectiveness declines. However, donating to multiple candidates can be complicated and time-consuming, and there could be hidden fees and expenses that make this less beneficial to the candidates. **That's why SCF allows you to donate to multiple candidates with one payment and why SCF pays all fundraising expenses related to those contributions.** _This saves candidates a ton of money._ As you know, processing fees are charged for all online transactions. What you probably don’t know is that candidates also often pay steep fundraising commissions to third-party vendors, which are at least 80% of the value of your contribution. Candidates have to pay outside vendors to help them find new donors across the country, and this service is quite expensive. **That means that when you get an email or text message from a candidate and click on the link to donate $100 to that candidate, the candidate will often get less than $20 after expenses.** This is why you should [**donate to candidates through SCF**](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=af15904fe91940d8b748103ca2119347&_e=6rUysTmjiUq1xZQqp-a2W7OMfRI4xhQ3GhQhIVE9PkUVYy94A2NpVW_VVLsQrHLA2IJaSaESy0zd7GNs97G-BV3gQZ3p_V3vd0v5LldRQuUSMGNnyb0ycZhXoeQYxrsNu4RwNbFiCaqeBEA2EoiwOo7E6dUTt_nWwzVXjcBgDLB64DGzJvIwfPVfDJxsMmoSlwm2lov-V4cZ8LjPWerx2fjdqfAGBOtMdgjoMaXiduU%3D) whenever possible. It’s one of the only ways to guarantee that the candidate will get 100% of your contribution with no hidden fees or expenses. And if you like our work and want to help us do more to promote good candidates, you can also contribute to SCF, which is our general fund. This will help us mobilize other patriots like you to help elect strong conservative leaders.

**2024 Senate Candidates**

Here’s the list of Senate candidates we are supporting this year — three incumbents and five challengers. ▶︎ Sen. Ted Cruz (TX) ▶︎ Sen. Rick Scott (FL)
▶︎ Sen. Josh Hawley (MO)

name: Heidi Ganahl
subject: The Mountain Minute: 10/2/2024
body:
JD Vance tops Tim Walz in first post-debate polling
| | | | [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
| | Hi folks,
This is the Mountain Minute for Wednesday, October 2, 2024.
– Heidi Ganahl
---
|
---
**TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
**[JD Vance tops Tim Walz in first post-debate polling](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [BREITBART](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
Sen. JD Vance’s (R-OH) regard for the facts appeared to help him out perform the sugar-coated whimsy of Minnesota Gov. Tim Walz (D) during Tuesday night’s vice presidential debate.
At least, that is the opinion of those polled immediately after the showdown by CBS News, which hosted the forum.
According to the CBS poll as seen by the Hill, 42 percent of debate watchers say Vance, a Yale-trained lawyer, won the debate.
Walz trails closely behind with 41 percent of viewers saying he was victorious. About 17 percent said it was a tie.
Nearly all, 88 percent, of debate viewers said the Vance-Walz face-off was generally positive, while 12 percent said it was generally negative, the survey showed.
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Rep. Armagost stresses voting in November: ‘There’s too much at stake and too much to lose’](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Rep. Ryan Armagost emphasized the importance of voter registration, education, and turnout for down-ballot candidates in the upcoming Nov. 5 general election, urging a significant increase in voter participation.
* Armagost, a former Marine, Army National Guard member, and law enforcement officer, highlighted key areas of concern on the ballot, including seven propositions and seven amendments that voters need to be informed about.
* He encouraged grassroots supporters to consider voting yes on two specific law enforcement propositions that do not involve tax increases, despite general opposition to tax hikes.
* Armagost is one of four Colorado candidates with an A+ rating from the National Rifle Association, alongside U.S. Rep. Lauren Boebert, state Sen. Larry Liston, and state Rep. Matt Soper.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Sherri Wright’s journey from cultivating fields to children lends to candidacy for state board of education](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Sherri Wright, a long-time educator and farmer, is running for the 3rd District seat on Colorado’s State Board of Education, focusing on parental rights, school choice, and traditional education.
* With 40 years of experience, she aims to ensure state policies reflect rural values and protect local schools. Wright opposes policies allowing transgender females in girls' restrooms, emphasizing student safety. She advocates for more transparency in education and a parental role in deciding what children are taught.
* Despite the challenges of running in a Democrat-majority board, Wright remains committed to being a strong voice for families in Colorado’s 3rd District.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Parker mayor, City Council forum featuring up to nine candidates is Thursday at Deep Space Lounge](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* A mayoral and City Council candidate forum in Parker will be held on Thursday, Oct. 3, hosted by the Downtown Business Alliance.
* The event will feature Jeff Toborg and Joshua Rivero for the mayoral race, and seven candidates vying for three at-large City Council seats.
* The forum is open to the public at the Deep Space Lounge, with a 6 p.m. arrival and no admission fee, though attendees must cover their own food and drinks.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Adam Frisch and Jeff Hurd are vying to replace Lauren Boebert in 3rd District. Here’s where they stand on the big issues.](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [THE COLORADO SUN](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Democrat Adam Frisch and Republican Jeff Hurd are running to represent Colorado's 3rd Congressional District, which includes the Western Slope and parts of southeastern Colorado. U.S. Rep. Lauren Boebert, who previously held the seat, is now running in the 4th Congressional District.
* Frisch, a former Aspen city councilman, and Hurd, a Grand Junction attorney, have shared their views on major issues such as the economy, immigration, and the environment in this competitive race.
* The district has a Republican lean, and voters' top concerns, including those highlighted in the Voter Voices 2024 survey, are shaping the candidates' positions on these key topics.

[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
|
---
**[Colorado ranching groups file petition to pause more wolf reintroductions until depredations are addressed](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [NBC 5 NEWS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* More than two dozen Colorado agriculture and livestock groups have filed a petition to delay further gray wolf reintroductions until proper conflict mitigation strategies are fully implemented.
* The petition asks Colorado Parks and Wildlife (CPW) to pause future wolf releases until measures, such as non-lethal prevention methods and rapid response teams, are in place to address wolf-livestock conflicts.
* Petitioners argue that the current wolf management plan doesn't adequately address wolf-related livestock losses, especially after 27 depredations were confirmed since the first wolf reintroduction.
* CPW has stated that it remains committed to the state's wolf restoration plan, with additional resources and mitigation strategies being planned for upcoming wolf releases.

[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
|
---
**[Caldara: Central planners disregard Coloradans’ true mobility needs](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY JON CALDARA, [COMPLETE COLORADO](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
_Tired of all the traffic? Tough. The central planners in charge command it only get worse at an exponential rate._
_The reason our roads suck is money that could fix and expand them goes to transit which relatively no one uses. U.S. Census data shows only 4% of Denver’s commuting population uses transit._
_Remember that number — 4%._
_Yet, in the Denver metro area, almost all “transportation” dollars go to transit. The Regional Transportation District’s (RTD) failed FasTracks scam spent more than $7 billion at a time when all the highway needs statewide were around $9 billion. We could have fulfilled nearly all of the Colorado Department of Transportation (CDOT) wish list for the entire state with what we spent on one choo-choo train boondoggle._
[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
|
---
**[Donald Trump: My plan to Make America Affordable Again, and bring back the American Dream](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY DONALD TRUMP, [NEWSWEEK](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
_For years, Americans have watched as our country has been stripped of our jobs and stripped of our wealth. We’ve watched our companies get sold off to foreign countries. But with my plan for the American economy, this will stop immediately. When I am president, we will begin to take other countries’ jobs and factories, bringing businesses and trillions of dollars back to the United States._

JD Vance’s (R-OH) regard for the facts appeared to help him out perform the sugar-coated whimsy of Minnesota Gov. Tim Walz (D) during Tuesday night’s vice presidential debate. At least, that is the opinion of those polled immediately after the showdown by CBS News, which hosted the forum. According to the CBS poll as seen by the Hill, 42 percent of debate watchers say Vance, a Yale-trained lawyer, won the debate. Walz trails closely behind with 41 percent of viewers saying he was victorious. About 17 percent said it was a tie. Nearly all, 88 percent, of debate viewers said the Vance-Walz face-off was generally positive, while 12 percent said it was generally negative, the survey showed. | Rep. subject: 5 good reasons

body:
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/94131820/502602831/-1905085255?refcode=email_090224_5-reasons-resend&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85Mzg4OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2MzhiM2UzZC1mMDgwLWVmMTEtODQ3NC02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=bZXyWnvm_okIQvV9TgTI0XYDwgvc5PIrl9yMjVSS1Pk=) I know I’m probably not the only candidate in this election emailing to ask for your support. (And sorry in advance for adding to your inbox clutter!) To me, that makes it especially important that I take some time to explain why this race, right here in Oregon, is deserving of your time and investment — because I don’t take your support, or anyone else’s, for granted. [_**If you already know that you’re all in on protecting this seat, I’d be honored if you would pitch in $5 and help me win this race (you can click this link to donate)**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/94131821/502602835/-1905085255?refcode=email_090224_5-reasons-resend&amounts=5,25,50,100,250,500,1000&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85Mzg4OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2MzhiM2UzZC1mMDgwLWVmMTEtODQ3NC02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=bZXyWnvm_okIQvV9TgTI0XYDwgvc5PIrl9yMjVSS1Pk=). But if you need more convincing, here are five reasons I am humbly asking for your support today: **1) Despite the extreme GOP majority in control of the House, I’ve worked hard to deliver real progress.** In fact, I’m proud to be one of the _only_ representatives — let alone first-term representatives — to pass a new law in this Congress. My legislation ensures that the Grand Ronde Tribe here in Oregon gets land compensation they are owed by the federal government. **2) I’m running proudly on my record of fighting for abortion rights.** Here in Oregon, I helped pass one of the nation’s most comprehensive reproductive rights bills. And now that I’m in Congress, I’m fighting to codify Roe v. Wade protections into law — so that no woman, in any state, can be criminalized simply for making a personal health care decision that some politician somewhere doesn’t like. **3) I know what it’s like when you feel like your family just can’t get ahead.** My dad immigrated to the U.S. from Mexico in 1950 and worked in the fields picking cotton and tomatoes before he was in first grade. He and my mom worked so hard, but when it was time for me to go to college, they didn’t have the money to afford both my education and their groceries. So I put myself through school instead. **4) Today, I’m working to make our economy fairer for families across our country who feel like they don’t have control over their own circumstances.** That means fighting for affordable health care, putting hardworking families over big corporations, and delivering national paid family and medical leave. **5) National Republicans are determined to defeat me — and it took everything we had to fight them off last time around.** This district is one of the most competitive in the whole country. Whichever party wins this seat is likely to win control of Congress, and it’s going to come down to just a handful of votes. [_**Unlike so many politicians, I’m not in this campaign because I like to hear myself talk. I’m here to get things done and fight for our values — but I can’t do it alone. If you’re with me, I hope you’ll pitch in $5 to help us win this race. It may not sound like it, but your support will go a LONG way to put us on a path to victory.**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/94131822/502602842/-1905085255?refcode=email_090224_5-reasons-resend&amounts=5,25,50,100,250,500,1000&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85Mzg4OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2MzhiM2UzZC1mMDgwLWVmMTEtODQ3NC02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=bZXyWnvm_okIQvV9TgTI0XYDwgvc5PIrl9yMjVSS1Pk=) _If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_ | | | | [Donate $5 →](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/94131823/502602850/-1905085255?refcode=email_090224_5-reasons-resend&amounts=5,25,50,100,250,500,1000&express_lane=true&amount=5&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85Mzg4OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2MzhiM2UzZC1mMDgwLWVmMTEtODQ3NC02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=bZXyWnvm_okIQvV9TgTI0XYDwgvc5PIrl9yMjVSS1Pk=)

name: No Dem Left Behind
subject: Across the Country: October 2nd, 2024
body:
Ongoing strikes on the East Coast could have huge impacts on the economy.
| | | | | |
---
**_Across the Country_**
---
|
---
Hello, folks! Welcome back to Across the Country, our weekly series from No Dem Left Behind! As the 2024 election draws nearer, we continue to focus on issues impacting battleground states. I’m Sabrina Niazi, and together with my colleague Daniela Rodriguez, we are committed to keeping you informed with in-depth analysis and key trends shaping the U.S. This week, let’s dive into the ongoing Port Workers Strike, which has sent shockwaves through the national economy.
---
| | | | **East Coast**
---
|
---
On October 1st, port workers from key East Coast and Gulf ports initiated a strike demanding wage increases and job security amidst growing concerns over automation. This historic strike has halted operations at major ports, including those in Philadelphia, Houston, and New York. The workers, represented by the International Longshoremen’s Association (ILA), are calling for a $5-per-hour wage increase and protections against automation, which they fear could replace their jobs. While it may seem like a localized issue, the impact is rippling across the nation. Experts predict significant delays in the supply chain, with perishable goods, such as fruits and vegetables, being among the most affected. Economic analysts have estimated losses ranging from $2.1 billion to $4.5 billion per day, depending on how long the strike lasts. These disruptions will inevitably drive up costs for businesses and consumers alike, as goods become harder to move across the country. This strike highlights the broader challenge of automation across industries and what it means for workers nationwide. The ILA’s demands aren’t just about wages—they're fighting for the future of work in America. Automation is threatening to displace jobs, and how we address this issue now could set the tone for labor relations in industries across the U.S. The economic losses are concerning, but the message these workers are sending is clear: fair wages and secure jobs are non-negotiable. As we move closer to the 2024 election, labor rights and automation will likely become central themes in political discourse, particularly in key battleground states where economic stability is a top concern for voters. Stay tuned for our next update, where we’ll continue exploring the pressing issues shaping the 2024 election. Stay informed with NDLB!
---
|
---
-Sabrina Niazi

# Sharon Clahchischilliage Invites President Donald Trump to New Mexico
---
| “Hey Donald Trump,
Sharon Clahchischilliage here. I am a candidate running for U.S. Congress New Mexico District 3. This is an invitation to you to come visit us here in (NM) District 3.
I want you to meet the people who are experiencing the effects of a buffer zone around Chaco Canyon.
I want you to meet the people of Mora County who have been left homeless because they have not been compensated from a fire that occurred two years ago in Mora County.
I want you to experience the people, the ranchers, the farmers, who are experiencing land grabs in their area. I need for you to. come here and see what the government is doing to District 3.
You know what? District 3 is rich. We have the Permian Basin. We have the San Juan Basin. Which is a big concern to the global energy world. We fund 50% of the state budget.
So, consider this a very important invitation President Trump. I need your help. I need you to help me show the people that we care. I need you to help me show the people that we CAN do something for them.”

Peter,

Once again, thank you for your support. It means everything. Let’s win this — together.

— Team Baccam

20 Remember your covenant promises,for the land is full of darkness and violence!21 Don’t let the downtrodden be humiliated again. Instead, let the poor and needy praise your name.22 Arise, O God, and defend your cause. Remember how these fools insult you all day long.—Psalm 74:20-22 I talk to people all the time, Believers and nonbelievers alike, and I am disturbed that a common thread runs between both groups—they feel anxious, distressed and downtrodden. body:
Without the threat of fact-checking, Vance used VP debate to present himself as a totally different person.

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/94134467/502611260/2130526953?refcode=emwrapper&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNDYxNjg3ZmEtZjU4MC1lZjExLTg0NzQtNjA0NWJkYThhYWU5IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=p-z7YcLblEftl8KrlYAHbLYwYkRsdruSbtpXfAL50r8=&emci=451687fa-f580-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&emdi=461687fa-f580-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&ceid=14016711)
Peter,
To the untrained eye (say, the eye of an undecided voter in a swing state), Tuesday’s Vice Presidential debate might have looked like a return to normal. Two “Midwest Nice” candidates discussing policy and setting aside the Trumpian personal attacks.
**Needless to say, the legacy media ate it up.**
[**We’ll break down how a fact-check-free debate allowed JD Vance to paint himself as a moderate while hiding his far-right agenda. But if you support COURIER’s mission to call out media bias and protect democracy, can you chip in $25 now?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/94134468/502611261/-593472309?refcode=20241002-EM-VPDebate&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNDYxNjg3ZmEtZjU4MC1lZjExLTg0NzQtNjA0NWJkYThhYWU5IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=p-z7YcLblEftl8KrlYAHbLYwYkRsdruSbtpXfAL50r8=)
Trump’s running mate, Ohio Senator JD Vance, is not the earnest Midwest moderate he pretended to be last night.
Since embracing the MAGA movement to win Trump’s endorsement in the Ohio Senate race, he’s been a champion for Project 2025 and its far-right, Christian nationalist blueprint to overhaul the federal government.
Vance supports a federal abortion ban, demonizes the LGBTQ+ community, and was responsible for the viral, totally false story about immigrants eating pets in his home state of Ohio.
But on Tuesday, without CBS moderators holding him to account, Vance wasn’t challenged on any of this.
Instead, he used the debate as a stage to rebrand himself as an aw-shucks moderate.
**Most notably, he falsely positioned himself—and by extension, the Republican Party—as pro-choice, despite his vocal support for a national abortion ban and previously comparing abortion to slavery.**
And here’s the point: When the legacy media fails to hold figures like Vance accountable, it misleads the public into believing they’re seeing a “balanced” perspective. The result? Voters walk away with a distorted view, thinking candidates like Vance are moderate when they’re anything but.
At COURIER, we refuse to play along with the fiction that Donald Trump and JD Vance represent “normal” politics. | | | **A Message from Team Goers Headquarters **
---

Dear Peter,
We are 34 days away from the election and it's all hands on deck here at the Goers headquarters! We wanted to take a moment to invite you all to join us this coming week for a few different activities that are happening around the district.

**_Doorbelling Opportunities:_**

We would love to have you join us this next week out knocking on doors!

**What to Expect:** We’ll provide you with all the materials you need and a brief training session to ensure you feel confident and prepared. Just make sure to bring your phone and some water!

**Why It Matters:**

1. **Personal Connection:** Door-to-door outreach allows us to engage directly with community members, answer their questions, and build personal connections.
2. **Raise Awareness:** It’s a chance to spread the word about Carmen and educate others about how they can get involved.
3. **Make an Impact:** Your efforts can lead to increased support and involvement, helping us all to win in November!

This next week we will be at:

**_Thursday, Oct. 3rd in Maple Valley 4:00 PM - 6:00 PM _**

* Location: 26800 236th Pl SE Maple Valley, WA 98038
* RSVP: [goerscampaign@gmail.com](mailto:goerscampaign@gmail.com)

** _Come help Dave Reichert & Team Goers! On Saturday Oct. 5th in Kent at 10AM_**

* Location: Green View Park @ 12033 SE 277th Pl, Kent, WA 98030
* RSVP: [ethan@reichertforgovernor.com](mailto:ethan@reichertforgovernor.com) or (206) 849-3367..

---
| | | |
---
| **_Come walk in our last parade! _**
If doorbelling isn’t your thing, join the rest of Team Goers in Issaquah for the Salmon Day Parade at 10:00 am on Saturday. Email us at [goerscampaign@gmail.com](mailto:goerscampaign@gmail.com) for more information and to sign up.

**_We got signs!_**
Want your very own Carmen Goers for Congress sign? Well we’ve got them! [Email us today](mailto:goerscampaign@gmail.com) and we will get a sign delivered right to your door!

---
| | | We can’t do this without your support. Carmen is knocking on doors and talking to voters as we are fast approaching the end of the election. Please consider [donating](https://vgq.soundestlink.com/ce/c/652845d9aa222127cf458b43/66fd9e65ea92f85feef03d71/66fda51509f464bc349b69da?signature=513f7f367748428c3bb8dccbd278a5eda03d172bcb6e4e4d639c66174938d7ea) or volunteering to help get her message out there. Contact us at [goerscampaign@gmail.com](mailto:goerscampaign@gmail.com) for other ways to volunteer with the campaign.

Thank you!

Team

name: Kristan Hawkins, Students for Life Action
subject: That debate wasn’t awful, but . . .
body:
Last night was the first and only VP Debate before... Dear Peter,

Last night was the first and only Vice-Presidential Debate before the 2024 election, and I have a few thoughts:
**1.** President Trump’s VP pick, Ohio Senator J.D. Vance held up extremely well against Vice President Kamala Harris’ radical VP pick, Minnesota Governor Tim Walz – _who at times looked like a deer caught in the headlights._ **2.** However, even though Senator Vance seemed to command the debate well _(outside of a few biased so-called “fact checks” from the CBS moderators),_ he could have done better on abortion.
To be clear, Sen. Vance wiped the floor with Gov. Walz on his support for an extreme Minnesota law he signed that allows for late-term abortions.

And I applaud him calling out the pure-evil abortion agenda of Kamala Harris and Tim Walz, as well as arguing for more pro-family policies.

But despite this, once again the Trump-Vance Campaign dodged the **TRUE** reality of abortion by saying abortion is merely a “states’ rights issue.”

Now, don’t get me wrong – ending the federal government’s role in abortion is certainly a robust agenda and it must start with defunding _Planned Parenthood_ of ALL of our tax-dollars and stopping the abortion-loving tyrants who have weaponized federal agencies like the _Department of Justice and Department of Health & Human Services_ against praying grandmas and pro-life physicians.

But . . . abortion is not merely a states’ rights issue . . . _**it’s a _HUMAN_ rights issue.**_

Because your right to be born shouldn’t be determined based on your location.

We tried that before in America . . . and it was a moral failure that lead to suffering and disaster.

Peter, first and foremost, you and I must make sure that Vice President Kamala Harris and Tim Walz never see the Oval Office, as it would be a disaster for preborn babies and their mothers across the country.

But once we’ve dodged that bullet, pro-lifers must hold President Trump and Sen. Vance accountable.

_If the Republican ticket wins this election, it will be because of the votes of pro-lifers._

President Trump and Senator Vance need to know that _our votes don’t come for free_.

America needs a President who will fight for a _Life at Conception Act_ on _**DAY ONE**_ – _the lives of countless preborn babies depend on it._

**[If you agree, please consider making your most generous contribution possible to _Students for Life Action_ to help fund our critical Election Year Programs](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/j16ZSCnCH815b6rkN8Hmvw~~/AAVkMwA~).**

And please pray for the hopeful leaders of this country, that they follow the voice of God – _the voice of Truth_ – instead of the political **LIES** of _Planned Parenthood_ and the Abortion Lobby.

Thank you for everything you do for Life, Peter.

For Life,

Kristan Hawkins
President, _Students for Life Action_

Or contact your healthcare provider directly.
**If you have insurance through a private insurer or Medicare or Medicaid, your vaccines will likely be covered at no cost to you.**
**Unfortunately, the federal Bridge Access Program that provided free vaccines to uninsured adults just ended in August** , leaving the most vulnerable communities behind. For the 25 million U.S. residents without health insurance, the out-of-pocket cost for these vaccines could be between $100 and $200.
**If you’re uninsured or underinsured, you can find where you may be able to get a free COVID vaccine by**[**checking with your local public health department**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.XaF8mXqsA6b2dSPmhsleMcirV_iXjn6EYhBQcqm0UTvPPB03mbR0dXOkOD503OQJ7tzH3Cy15Jd5iHYFsjbEKAlA6n0TpAFCEgGTD0OV2Mh1LVci9OM1rno7oNymOaFXPvkFGDeExHWKR8rdITA93aitxxiEBvwGgSesXG4IoQEpBid5EHxoucXxB-EXJTCpGm071Utvs0NO-C6QMljnUv1O-gAWD-966XLuRPnPWf2gjQu8DhvKTqLa3s8otAobGsVjWabRmo9Z6GKe1jRGnueE_7pwWL-URh5-PVhuF3k/4a9/QDIUjxzpS8OzP_7toYHDgg/h8/h001.1jH5Ko9zzjYe7C6jWnUmxJ0zn8hhp7f49n6m_YTmCac)**.** Let them know that you do not have health insurance. In Michigan, our state’s Adult Vaccine Program has received thousands of doses to provide for free or reduced cost at local health departments and Tribal health centers.
**Uninsured children aged 18 and younger can still get COVID-19 vaccines and other vaccines for free through the federal Vaccines for Children Program.** Please check with your child’s doctor’s office or use the above link to find your local health department.
While staying up-to-date with the latest vaccines helps to lower the chances of infection and reduce the risk of developing long COVID, experts recommend using multiple layers of protection to keep ourselves and our communities safe.
People can be contagious without having symptoms, so testing regularly also helps prevent spread. **Keep an eye out toward the end of this month: The U.S. Department of Health and Human Services will again ship up to four free COVID-19 tests per household, which you’ll be able to order online.**
If you do test positive for COVID-19, you can reduce the risk of developing long COVID by resting as much as possible and checking with your healthcare provider about getting a prescription for Paxlovid.
Gathering outdoors is another way to reduce risk. When indoors, we can reduce the amount of time the virus stays in the air by filtering or ventilating indoor air by using air purifiers and opening windows. Spread by people’s breath, COVID is an airborne virus that lingers in the air like smoke, which is why wearing well-fitting masks is another important layer of protection.
I promise to continue fighting in Congress for a stronger social safety net, including more federal funding for COVID-19 protections, lower prescription prices, an end to medical debt, and free healthcare for all.
Always serving you,
Rashida

subject: 👍 Tim Walz vs. JD Vance 👎

body:
Governor Walz and Vice President Harris are the only candidates who will work to keep our communities safe
#

Friends -
Last night’s vice presidential debate between Governor Tim Walz and JD Vance served as another stark reminder that a Trump-Vance administration would be a huge setback in our work towards a future free from gun violence.
**As a refresher, here’s JD Vance’s record on guns:**
* 👎 Vance **_opposes**_ universal background checks.

* 👎 Vance **_supports concealed carry reciprocity.**_ In states that have weakened standards for concealed carry, violent crime rates rose by 13-15 percent.

* 👎 When the Senate tried to reinstate a federal bump stock ban after the Supreme Court struck down the ATF’s ban, **_Vance called bump stocks “fake problems.”**_ Bump stocks have been used in some of the most fatal mass shootings in modern history, such as the 2017 shooting at the Route 91 Harvest music festival in Las Vegas.

* 👎 After last month’s shooting at a high school in Winder, GA that left two students and two teachers dead, **_Vance called school shootings a “fact of life.”_**

**Meanwhile, here’s a bit about Tim Walz’s record:**
* 👍 In the US House of Representatives, then-Representative Walz voted to **_expand background checks**_ and to **_fund CDC research**_ into gun violence.

* 👍 As governor, he passed **_significant gun safety legislation in Minnesota,**_ including a background checks and extreme risk protection order bill.

* 👍 Governor Walz is a **_responsible gun owner,**_ giving him a special perspective on the importance of gun safety.

Governor Walz and Vice President Harris are the only candidates who will work to keep our communities safe from gun violence. We must do everything we can to elect them this November.

body:
Can Sarah count on you?
#
Sarah’s primary victory last month was resounding, thanks to this movement showing up big — but this race isn’t over yet.
As we head into the final weeks of the general election, we need your help to cross the finish line!
[**Will you be one of the 5,000 personal endorsements we need to show the strength of this campaign and propel Sarah to victory in November?**](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/signup/em-endorse-sarah_GE/?source=em20241002-1-1314&akid=1314%2E21716%2EVt8roo)
**[Endorse Sarah »](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/signup/em-endorse-sarah_GE/?source=em20241002-1-1314&akid=1314%2E21716%2EVt8roo)**
Delaware has _one_ seat in Congress. **So when Sarah launched her campaign for Congress, we knew we were going to need a huge grassroots coalition behind her to win.**
**We’re beyond grateful that over the past year, dozens of organizations, elected officials, and activists — in addition to tens of thousands of people up and down Delaware and across the country — have joined Team McBride.**
They know she has a proven track record of fighting for the issues that matter most to Delawareans – from expanding access to affordable healthcare and increasing the minimum wage to protecting reproductive rights.
**She’ll also make history as the first-ever openly trans member of Congress.** And for Sarah, being a "first" isn't enough – she's determined to ensure she won't be the last.
In her own words: "For someone who's scared and feels alone, it could potentially be a lifesaving message to go to sleep in November seeing that someone like them is able to fully participate in our democracy, that they can be seen as full human beings."
But while Sarah is focused on uniting people and delivering results, we face significant opposition.
Her MAGA opponent is boosting Project 2025, saying it “is restoring our Republic.” The far-right has also launched attacks against her, and we know these will only intensify as we get closer to Election Day.
**This is why your endorsement is so crucial.** By adding your name, you’re showing that our movement has Sarah’s back. Let’s send a powerful message that we stand united behind her vision for a better America.
[**Will you take a moment right now to endorse Sarah’s campaign for Congress?**](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/signup/em-endorse-sarah_GE/?source=em20241002-1-1314&akid=1314%2E21716%2EVt8roo)
**[Endorse Sarah »](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/signup/em-endorse-sarah_GE/?source=em20241002-1-1314&akid=1314%2E21716%2EVt8roo)**
Onward,
Team McBride
* * *
**[Donate »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-footer?refcode=em20241002-1&t=1&refcode2=1314_21716_Vt8roo&akid=1314%2E21716%2EVt8roo)**
This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is a critical way we communicate with grassroots supporters like you. However, if you would like to change your subscription preferences, here are some options:
* [Receive Fewer Emails](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/signup/receive_fewer_emails/?t=2&akid=1314%2E21716%2EVt8roo)
* [Update Your Information](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/signup/update_your_information/?t=3&akid=1314%2E21716%2EVt8roo)
* [Unsubscribe](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?t=4&akid=1314%2E21716%2EVt8roo)

subject: HUUUUUGE MARGINS!

body:
John is on the ground, going county to county, to spread the word and start the blue wave in PA!
#
Derek,
Over the past few weeks, John has been on the ground meeting with voters in county after county – and folks are FIRED UP to support a massive operation to get folks in PA to vote BLUE!
In this election, _every single vote_ will matter. Whether it’s Anna Thomas in Lehigh Valley or Bob Casey or even Kamala Harris and Tim Walz at the top of the ticket, critical races will be decided by just a few votes.
**[If you are ready to get to work, will you make your first $5 donation towards electing Democrats in Pennsylvania in 4 weeks?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20241002?refcode=em20241002-9442&refcode2=9442_434096_X4Ip46&akid=9442%2E434096%2EX4Ip46)**
John has met so many amazing people in red and blue counties who are energized + mobilizing to get out every single vote possible. These folks are in the trenches doing the day-to-day things that will deliver PA for Dems. Knocking on doors, talking to neighbors, educating their friends, making plans to vote together – you name it, they’re ON IT!
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20241002?refcode=em20241002-9442&refcode2=9442_434096_X4Ip46&akid=9442%2E434096%2EX4Ip46)
John has said it before, and we’ll say it again: whoever wins PA will take the White House. **County by county, we can turn PA 🔵 and deliver a historic Kamala Harris presidency to the entire nation!**
We’ve got just over **30 days** before the election is over. In those 30-odd days, John is going to keep joining Democrats in red PA counties to keep up the energy + turnout the vote for Kamala Harris, Tim Walz, Bob Casey, and all the Democrats on the ballot this year.
**[While he’s putting miles to the mission, can John Fetterman count on you to contribute to turning Pennsylvania blue in November? Every dollar you send is an extra voter we can reach and ensures a wider margin to win big on Election Night.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20241002?refcode=em20241002-9442&refcode2=9442_434096_X4Ip46&akid=9442%2E434096%2EX4Ip46)**

If we come together now, we will deliver PA for Democrats. We can just feel it!
💙 Team Fetterman

I’ve got no business running for the U.S. Senate – and that’s exactly why I am. = Hey there, My name is Dan Osborn, and I am the candidate running for U.S. Senate against Republican Deb Fischer here in Nebraska. I know what you’re thinking. I get a lot of eye rolls when I say the word Nebraska and tell people that I’m running against a Republican. A lot of people don’t think we can win against a two-term incumbent who has an (R) next to her name. But give me the chance to explain why they’re wrong. The people of Nebraska are ready for change. SEVEN new polls show me neck-and-neck with Republican Deb Fischer – and in the latest poll, I am even LEADING by one point! Nebraskans are fed up with Washington. Both parties – Democrats and Republicans – are full of too many people that have been bought and paid for by corporations and billionaires. The Republicans don’t look out for blue-collar working people like me, and too many Democrats in DC don’t seem to understand rural America anymore. I’m not rich, and I don’t come from some political dynasty. I’ve got no business running for the U.S. Senate – and that’s exactly why I am. I am a proud card-carrying steamfitter and mechanic. I was president of my local union before I got fired for leading a strike that saved 500 middle-class jobs in Nebraska. I served in the United States Navy and joined the National Guard to help pay for college before I had to drop out so I could keep food on the table for my family. There’s nobody like me in the Senate. But with your help, I believe we can win and finally elect a senator whose collars are blue. And these new polls showing me in the lead prove it. body:
Thank you so much, Peter
#
Hi Peter, it’s Lucas Kunce with a quick update about our Q3 fundraising.
**We’re still counting all the numbers, but it’s safe to say that — between the fundraising, the energy we’re feeling on the ground, and the polls that show this race getting tighter — we had our best quarter yet.** My team will share more about all that soon, but for now I just wanted to reach out to say thank you.
Insiders thought I was crazy when I decided to run this campaign the right way — without any money from corporate PACs or Big Oil + Big Pharma execs. But real people like you have stepped up to prove them wrong by helping us hit our goals at nearly every single deadline.
That support has allowed us to hold Josh Hawley accountable for crusading against reproductive rights and embarrassing our state. It’s helped us earn major in-state and national endorsements from groups like the Missouri AFL-CIO, Missouri Fire Fighters, VoteVets, and End Citizens United. And it’s made this race our best chance to flip a U.S. Senate seat this November.
We’ve got some serious MO-mentum. **But now, with less than 5 WEEKS until Election Day, we’ve still got the most important work ahead of us.**
From defending our movement against the onslaught of attacks by Hawley and his GOP Super PAC to holding more big events across Missouri, we’ve got to make sure our campaign has the resources we need to fund all that and more.
We are doing everything possible to keep exposing Hawley’s record and getting our message in front of voters. And your continued support is what makes that possible for our movement.
I can’t tell you how much it means to me that you’re part of this team, Peter. I know that together, we can defeat Josh Hawley, flip Missouri’s U.S. Senate seat, and take back power for working Missourians this November.
Now, let’s keep moving.
— Lucas Kunce

[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/94140090/502630409/664783965?ms=100224_PostVPDebate&utm_campaign=cia&utm_medium=email&utm_source=ea&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNV08vMS83NjczNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0NmJmNzU2MC0wMzgxLWVmMTEtODQ3NC02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=3H7E9nyZR4oSzaK_d4wJ52X8seaqYzJLAUquwtxCzf8=&emci=e8ad45b5-eb80-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&emdi=46bf7560-0381-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&ceid=864787)
Hi Peter,

With only a month to go until the November election, care continues to take center stage. Last week, Kamala Harris outlined her [**economic plan,**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/94140091/502630410/-97383074?ms=100224_PostVPDebate&utm_campaign=cia&utm_medium=email&utm_source=ea&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNV08vMS83NjczNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0NmJmNzU2MC0wMzgxLWVmMTEtODQ3NC02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=3H7E9nyZR4oSzaK_d4wJ52X8seaqYzJLAUquwtxCzf8=&emci=e8ad45b5-eb80-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&emdi=46bf7560-0381-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&ceid=864787) making it clear how essential—and personal—care is for all of us. In yesterday’s Vice Presidential debate, Tim Walz emphasized how the skyrocketing cost of care is one of the biggest issues facing families today.

clean_body: It’s up to us to make sure voters know that we need to elect representatives who will fight for care workers and women of color. Hi Peter, With only a month to go until the November election, care continues to take center stage. Last week, Kamala Harris outlined her making it clear how essential—and personal—care is for all of us. In yesterday’s Vice Presidential debate, Tim Walz emphasized how the skyrocketing cost of care is one of the biggest issues facing families today. It’s up to us to make sure voters know that we need to elect representatives who will fight for care workers and women of color. Every vote is going to matter in this election, which is why it’s critical that those of us who are passionate about care use our voices to talk to voters this weekend. Kamala Harris captured the importance of caregiving in “Caregiving is about dignity – and when we lower the cost and ease the burdens people face, we will not only make it then easier for them to meet their obligations as caregivers, we will also make it more possible for them to go to work and pursue their economic aspirations.” Thank you, The Care in Action Team

name: Derek Lyons - RITE
subject: RITE Acts to Ensure Only Eligible Citizens Vote in North Carolina Elections
body:
NC's Constitution requires individuals to reside in the state to vote |
---
| |
---
| |
# **RITE Acts to Ensure Only Eligible Citizens Vote in North Carolina Elections**

Restoring Integrity and Trust in Elections (RITE), a non-profit organization that supports litigation to protect election security and integrity, today [filed suit against the North Carolina State Board of Elections](https://riteusa.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=dc5917dfc5aa19cc3795efbb2&id=e493cc9767&e=ea91f782ea) (“NCSBE”) to ensure that only eligible citizens can vote in North Carolina elections. North Carolina’s Constitution specifically requires individuals to reside in the state in order to vote. However, a state statute directly conflicts with this requirement by permitting those to vote who claim to be citizens but have never resided in North Carolina or even the United States. This statute is unconstitutional and must be struck down to ensure that only ballots cast by eligible resident citizens count.

The NCSBE has also directed county officials to disregard important voter ID requirements for these voters. Federal and state laws require officials to match individuals’ driver’s license or the last four digits of social security numbers when they register to vote. When officials are unable to verify these numbers when checking official databases, the federal Help America Vote Act (“HAVA”) and state law require these voters to provide ID when returning their ballots. Federal law exempts military and certain overseas voters from this ID requirement, but not those have never resided in the United States. The NCSBE has unlawfully applied this federal exemption to these voters and they must be stopped.

Derek Lyons, RITE’s CEO and President, issued the following statement:

“The North Carolina Constitution’s voter qualifications unequivocally require residency. However, the state is permitting individuals who have never resided in North Carolina, let alone the United States, to vote in all of the state’s elections, from President down to local offices.

"To make matters worse, the state’s Board of Elections has instructed county officials to ignore important laws that help verify the citizenship and identity of these 'never resided' voters.

"Voting for our eligible military and overseas should be easy, but that does not extend to those ineligible to vote, nor does it mean ignoring crucial verification requirements for others living in foreign countries who claim to be citizens.

"We are confident that the courts will order North Carolina to end its unlawful practices that are undermining citizens’ confidence in overseas voting.”
#

Take a look at these headlines,
Peter:

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/signup/petition_20241002_green_new_deal/?source=em20241002-36040&akid=36040%2E1203867%2ErQgI49 ]Yahoo News: Helene shows that hurricanes in the age of climate change
don’t wreck just coastlines

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/signup/petition_20241002_green_new_deal/?source=em20241002-36040&akid=36040%2E1203867%2ErQgI49 ]NBC News: Helene rainfall boosted by human-driven climate change,
studies find

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/signup/petition_20241002_green_new_deal/?source=em20241002-36040&akid=36040%2E1203867%2ErQgI49 ]The Guardian: ‘Nowhere is safe’: shattered Asheville shows stunning
reach of climate crisis

Hurricane Helene made landfall in Florida as a category 4 storm and went
on to devastate communities across five different states. Not only did it
destroy coastal towns, but as The Guardian reports, “it mangled places in
multiple states that have never seen such impacts, obliterating small
towns, hurling trees onto homes, unmooring houses that then floated in the
floodwater, plunging millions of people into power blackouts and turning
major roads into rivers.”

More than 160 people have died with hundreds more missing and tens of
thousands still without power. Nealy one-third of deaths took place in the
North Carolina county containing the city of Asheville, a place previously
considered a ‘haven’ from climate change’s negative effects.

It’s clear: climate change is here, and nobody is safe from its impacts.
Scientists have confirmed that human-induced climate change made this
historic hurricane possible, and it’s only the beginning if we fail to
take urgent, drastic measures to prevent and mitigate the climate crisis.

Now more than ever, we need the Green New Deal: bold, comprehensive
legislation to transition the United States to 100% renewable energy,
invest in electric vehicles and public transit, upgrade buildings and
infrastructure, and create millions of good-paying jobs.

Every Justice Democrats member of Congress backs the Green New Deal, but
we need to keep the pressure up on the rest of our elected officials to
take action before it’s truly too late. [ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/signup/petition_20241002_green_new_deal/?source=em20241002-36040&akid=36040%2E1203867%2ErQgI49 ]Add your name to reaffirm your

In solidarity,

Justice Democrats

With concrete, actionable steps, he discussed plans to expand access to affordable child care, aging and disability care, paid leave, and better wages for care workers.
[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/94141551/502635240/598918572?ms=100224_VP_debate&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNV08vMS83NjczNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3NWI5OWRiNy0wOTgxLWVmMTEtODQ3NC02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=J6I8yQ5lf3gRTh47FZ56kG3Q36Nnz3Si8mJsIrqKAr0=&emci=358a4052-0581-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&emdi=75b99db7-0981-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&ceid=864787)

[**_Read our full statement on the debate:_**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/94141552/502635241/1105190466?ms=100224_VP_debate&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNV08vMS83NjczNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3NWI5OWRiNy0wOTgxLWVmMTEtODQ3NC02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=J6I8yQ5lf3gRTh47FZ56kG3Q36Nnz3Si8mJsIrqKAr0=&emci=358a4052-0581-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&emdi=75b99db7-0981-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&ceid=864787)

Let’s see how Vance and Walz’s plans stack up on care:
**The Trump-Vance ticket:**
* Has never fought for care
* Plans to weaken Medicaid and Medicare
* Will dismantle childcare programs like Head Start
* Has no plans to solve the care crisis

**The Harris-Walz ticket:**
* Has fought to raise wages for home care workers in Minnesota
* Expanded paid family leave in Minnesota
* Expanded the Child Tax Credit nationwide
* Plans to strengthen jobs for care workers
* Plans to invest in high-quality child care, aging care, and long‐term care

clean_body: Walz is the Vice President working families need Hi Peter, During last night’s Vice Presidential debate, Governor Tim Walz showed us that he’s serious about taking action to support care workers and families. With concrete, actionable steps, he discussed plans to expand access to affordable child care, aging and disability care, paid leave, and better wages for care workers. JD Vance, on the other hand, failed to explain how he and Donald Trump would address the care crisis. Instead, he espoused harmful lies about immigrants and vague talking points. Let’s see how Vance and Walz’s plans stack up on care: The Trump-Vance ticket: Has never fought for care Plans to weaken Medicaid and Medicare Will dismantle childcare programs like Head Start Has no plans to solve the care crisis The Harris-Walz ticket: Has fought to raise wages for home care workers in Minnesota Expanded paid family leave in Minnesota Expanded the Child Tax Credit nationwide Plans to strengthen jobs for care workers * Plans to invest in high-quality child care, aging care, and long‐term care Thank you for standing with us and the millions of care workers and families nationwide, Peter. Hillary Holley Executive Director | Care in Action

We cannot let Donald Trump and J.D. Vance anywhere near the White House

|
---

| | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/94141828/502636084/176588961?refcode=MW_ATA_EM_FR_Debate_241002_T1_2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiNWRiYTMxMy0wYTgxLWVmMTEtODQ3NC02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=V0ObHu6e0fKo1lN4kOeD3kt1YFDuqeGXsbVrERWOiTg=) Derek,

If you tuned in to the Vice-Presidential debate yesterday like I did, I’m sure you have some thoughts.

**Trump picked Vance as his running mate because Vance is the epitome of a yes-man.** How else would Vance go from being a “never-Trump guy” (_yes, those are Vance’s own words_) to his VP candidate? All Vance cares about is climbing the political ladder. He wants to ride Trump’s coattails all the way to the White House.

And then of course there’s the fact that they don’t have a plan to fix the problems facing our communities. Trump said it himself. All he has are “concepts of a plan.” Meanwhile Democrats have a vision. We have a plan – and we’re ready to get it done.

We’re not wasting time “repealing and replacing Obamacare.” We’re passing legislation that caps insulin prices. We’re trying to expand the Child Tax Credit so working families have a little more breathing room in their budgets. Unlike Trump and Vance, we’re not dodging questions about national abortion bans. We’re protecting and expanding a woman’s right to reproductive health care.

Look, Derek, we cannot let Donald Trump and J.D. Vance anywhere near the White House. They’re a danger to our democracy and our country.

Thank you,

Mark Warner

name: AOC
subject: Last week in Pennsylvania
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
This will mark the first year of people looking towards our generation to set the agenda.
#
If we can turn out the young vote, then elections hinge on us. And if the election hinges on us, then that means **we get to decide the agenda**.
We’re going to want to see an end to endless war. We’re going to want to see expanding healthcare, and action on climate change.
And we’re going to want to see the Supreme Court and Republicans **keep their hands off our bodies and out of our business**.
We cannot allow all of this to continue because, at the end of the day, we’re going to have to live in this world that they leave us.
I don’t know about you, but I’m tired of being _left_ a world — I’m here to _make_ the world.
We were just in Pennsylvania with Summer Lee, driving home this message with young voters: **a brighter future is possible, and this is your chance to dive in and win it**.
[Will you split a $2 contribution between our teams — $1 for each campaign — so that we can keep this fight strong through November 5th and beyond? ](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20241002-summer.IVun2v&refcode=em20241002-7321-P_FND_SPL_CTR&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=7321%2E2526796%2EsAC8L-)
**[Contribute $2](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20241002-summer.IVun2v&refcode=em20241002-7321-P_FND_SPL_CTR&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=20&akid=7321%2E2526796%2EsAC8L-)**
I’m so excited because, when we deliver it this year, it will mark the first year of people looking towards our generation to set the agenda.
In solidarity,
Alexandria

Team — Last week, Vice President Harris joined Arizona leaders at the border to hear directly from Arizonans impacted by our failing immigration system. This November, we have the opportunity to elect a President who is fighting for an immigration system that is secure, fair, orderly, and humane. All Arizonans deserve a border that is safe, secure, and wants every person to be treated with dignity and respect. But the stark differences between Republicans and Democrats on this issue couldn’t be clearer. The GOP’s immigration plan includes bringing back his infamous Muslim ban, restricting asylum, and conducting mass raids across the country — **_they’ve even promised a 100% deportation rate at the border. _** This isn’t just hateful rhetoric — it’s a plan for ripping our families and communities apart. These proposed policies are dangerous and dehumanizing. This cannot be further from our values as Arizonans. We’ve already seen what Trump’s words can do. He demonizes immigrant communities, feeding his base hate and lies. And his promise of a "bloodbath" if he resumes mass deportations makes it clear that if he wins in November, we will see a terrifying escalation of cruelty toward immigrant communities, with devastating consequences for families across the nation. * **TOP NEWS**

**" How two billionaire preachers remade Texas politics,"** Nww York Times Magazine's**Ava Kofman** -- "Last December, **Sid Miller** , the Texas commissioner of agriculture, posted a photo of himself brandishing a double-barrel shotgun on X and invited his followers to join him on a "RINO hunt." Miller had taken to stumping in the March primary election against incumbents he deemed to be Republicans in Name Only. Not long after that, he received a text message from one of his targets, a state representative named **Glenn Rogers**. "You are a bought and paid for, pathetic narcissist," it began. "If you had any honor, you would challenge me, or any of my Republican colleagues to a duel."

Rogers, a 68-year-old rancher and grandfather of five, represents a rural district west of Fort Worth. He was proud to serve in a Legislature that, as he told me recently, "couldn't be more conservative if it tried." Since entering office in 2021, he co-authored legislation that allowed Texans to carry handguns without a permit, supported the Heartbeat Act that grants citizens the right to sue abortion providers and voted to give the police the power to arrest suspected undocumented migrants in schools and hospitals. In a Statehouse packed with debate-me agitators, he was comparatively soft-spoken -- a former professor of veterinary medicine with an aversion to grandstanding. He was not in the habit of firing off salvos, as he had to Miller, that ended with "Kiss My Ass!"

But the viciousness of the primary season had been getting to him. Nearly a year before the March elections, ads began to appear in Rogers's district castigating him not simply as a RINO but as a closet liberal who supported gun control and Shariah law. (Rogers was especially peeved by an ad that photoshopped his signature white cowboy hat onto a headshot of **Joe Biden**.) Some of the attacks originated from his challenger's campaign, while others were sponsored by organizations with grassroots-sounding names, like Texans for Fiscal Responsibility, Texas Gun Rights and Texas Family Project. By the time voters headed to the polls, they could have been forgiven for thinking that Rogers had disappointed a suite of conservative groups.

In reality, Rogers had disappointed two men: **Tim Dunn** and **Farris Wilks** , billionaires who have made their fortunes in the oil industry. Over the past decade, the pair have built the most powerful political machine in Texas -- a network of think-tanks, media organizations, political-action committees and nonprofits that work in lock step to purge the Legislature of Republicans whose votes they can't rely on. Cycle after cycle, their relentless maneuvering has pushed the Statehouse so far to the right that consultants like to joke that Karl Rove couldn't win a local race these days. **Brandon Darby** , the editor of Breitbart Texas, is one of several conservatives who has compared Dunn and Wilks to Russian oligarchs. "They go into other communities and unseat people unwilling to do their bidding," he says. "You kiss the ring or you're out."

Like the Koch brothers, the Mercer family and other conservative billionaires, Dunn and Wilks want to slash regulations and taxes. Their endgame, however, is more radical: not just to limit the government but also to steer it toward Christian rule. "It's hard to think of other megafunders in the country as big on the theocratic end of the spectrum," says **Peter Montgomery** , who oversees the Right Wing Watch project at People for the American Way, a progressive advocacy group.

Texas, which has few limits on campaign spending, is home to a formidable army of donors. Lately Dunn has outspent them all. Since 2000, he and his wife have given more than $29 million to candidates and PACs in Texas. Wilks and his wife, who have donated to many of the same PACs as Dunn, have given $16 million. Last year, Dunn and his associated entities provided two thirds of the donations to the state Republican Party.

The duo's ambitions extend beyond Texas. They've poured millions into "dark money" groups, which do not have to disclose contributors; conservative-media juggernauts (Wilks provided $4.7 million in seed capital to The Daily Wire, which hosts "The Ben Shapiro Show"); and federal races. Dunn's $5 million gift to the Make America Great Again super PAC in December made him one of**Donald Trump 's **top supporters this election season, and he has quietly begun to invest in efforts to influence a possible second Trump administration, including several [linked to Project 2025](https://substack.com/redirect/edcacb36-08bf-4db1-a5bf-9bbff68f4dfe?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).

Rogers believes he provoked the ire of the Dunn and Wilks machine for two reasons. He refused to support a school-voucher bill that would funnel taxpayer dollars to private schools, and he voted to [impeach](https://substack.com/redirect/e321c358-378e-454e-9626-06d7340c4d8f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Attorney General **Ken Paxton** , one of the machine's most powerful allies. (Paxton, who did not respond to requests for comment, was impeached in part for misusing his office to help a friend under federal investigation.)

Since neither of these issues particularly excited voters, many attacks focused on distorting Rogers's record on immigration instead. When his wife joined a text group for the spouses of incumbents under siege (they called themselves the Badass Babes), she saw that her husband was not the only opponent of vouchers who had supposedly given Democrats "control of the Texas border." The mailers sent across the state were identical, with only the names and faces swapped out.

The onslaught worked. Rogers lost his seat by 27 percentage points, and more than two dozen Statehouse candidates backed by the two billionaires prevailed this spring. These challengers received considerable support from Dunn-and-Wilks-backed allies like Miller, the agricultural commissioner, as well as from G.O.P. heavyweights like Gov. **Greg Abbott**. "You cannot overstate the absolute earthquake that was the March 5 primary," says **Matt Mackowiak** , a political consultant and chairman of the Travis County G.O.P." ($5/mo or $50/yr or $199 lifetime) TOP NEWS " How two billionaire preachers remade Texas politics," Nww York Times Magazine'sAva Kofman -- "Last December, Sid Miller , the Texas commissioner of agriculture, posted a photo of himself brandishing a double-barrel shotgun on X and invited his followers to join him on a "RINO hunt." Miller had taken to stumping in the March primary election against incumbents he deemed to be Republicans in Name Only. Not long after that, he received a text message from one of his targets, a state representative named Glenn Rogers. "You are a bought and paid for, pathetic narcissist," it began. "If you had any honor, you would challenge me, or any of my Republican colleagues to a duel." Rogers, a 68-year-old rancher and grandfather of five, represents a rural district west of Fort Worth. He was proud to serve in a Legislature that, as he told me recently, "couldn't be more conservative if it tried." Since entering office in 2021, he co-authored legislation that allowed Texans to carry handguns without a permit, supported the Heartbeat Act that grants citizens the right to sue abortion providers and voted to give the police the power to arrest suspected undocumented migrants in schools and hospitals. In a Statehouse packed with debate-me agitators, he was comparatively soft-spoken -- a former professor of veterinary medicine with an aversion to grandstanding. He was not in the habit of firing off salvos, as he had to Miller, that ended with "Kiss My Ass!" But the viciousness of the primary season had been getting to him. Nearly a year before the March elections, ads began to appear in Rogers's district castigating him not simply as a RINO but as a closet liberal who supported gun control and Shariah law. (Rogers was especially peeved by an ad that photoshopped his signature white cowboy hat onto a headshot of Joe Biden.) Some of the attacks originated from his challenger's campaign, while others were sponsored by organizations with grassroots-sounding names, like Texans for Fiscal Responsibility, Texas Gun Rights and Texas Family Project. By the time voters headed to the polls, they could have been forgiven for thinking that Rogers had disappointed a suite of conservative groups. In reality, Rogers had disappointed two men: Tim Dunn and Farris Wilks , billionaires who have made their fortunes in the oil industry. Over the past decade, the pair have built the most powerful political machine in Texas -- a network of think-tanks, media organizations, political-action committees and nonprofits that work in lock step to purge the Legislature of Republicans whose votes they can't rely on. Cycle after cycle, their relentless maneuvering has pushed the Statehouse so far to the right that consultants like to joke that Karl Rove couldn't win a local race these days. Brandon Darby , the editor of Breitbart Texas, is one of several conservatives who has compared Dunn and Wilks to Russian oligarchs. "They go into other communities and unseat people unwilling to do their bidding," he says. "You kiss the ring or you're out." Like the Koch brothers, the Mercer family and other conservative billionaires, Dunn and Wilks want to slash regulations and taxes. Their endgame, however, is more radical: not just to limit the government but also to steer it toward Christian rule. "It's hard to think of other megafunders in the country as big on the theocratic end of the spectrum," says Peter Montgomery , who oversees the Right Wing Watch project at People for the American Way, a progressive advocacy group. Texas, which has few limits on campaign spending, is home to a formidable army of donors. Lately Dunn has outspent them all. Since 2000, he and his wife have given more than $29 million to candidates and PACs in Texas. Wilks and his wife, who have donated to many of the same PACs as Dunn, have given $16 million. Last year, Dunn and his associated entities provided two thirds of the donations to the state Republican Party. The duo's ambitions extend beyond Texas. They've poured millions into "dark money" groups, which do not have to disclose contributors; conservative-media juggernauts (Wilks provided $4.7 million in seed capital to The Daily Wire, which hosts "The Ben Shapiro Show"); and federal races. Dunn's $5 million gift to the Make America Great Again super PAC in December made him one ofDonald Trump 's top supporters this election season, and he has quietly begun to invest in efforts to influence a possible second Trump administration, including several . Rogers believes he provoked the ire of the Dunn and Wilks machine for two reasons. He refused to support a school-voucher bill that would funnel taxpayer dollars to private schools, and he voted to Attorney General Ken Paxton , one of the machine's most powerful allies. (Paxton, who did not respond to requests for comment, was impeached in part for misusing his office to help a friend under federal investigation.) Since neither of these issues particularly excited voters, many attacks focused on distorting Rogers's record on immigration instead. When his wife joined a text group for the spouses of incumbents under siege (they called themselves the Badass Babes), she saw that her husband was not the only opponent of vouchers who had supposedly given Democrats "control of the Texas border." The mailers sent across the state were identical, with only the names and faces swapped out. The onslaught worked. Rogers lost his seat by 27 percentage points, and more than two dozen Statehouse candidates backed by the two billionaires prevailed this spring. These challengers received considerable support from Dunn-and-Wilks-backed allies like Miller, the agricultural commissioner, as well as from G.O.P. heavyweights like Gov. Greg Abbott. "You cannot overstate the absolute earthquake that was the March 5 primary," says Matt Mackowiak , a political consultant and chairman of the Travis County G.O.P." Dear Friend,

Politics often leaves a bitter taste in our mouths. It's no wonder so many of us approach it with disdain. The endless mudslinging, pandering to special interest groups, and policies shaped by poll numbers rather than deeply held convictions make politics seem like a world Christians should avoid.

Yet, as Christians, we can't ignore the rapid unraveling of our culture or remain passive in the face of the evil we see around us. The Bible tells us that our citizenship is in heaven (Philippians 3:20) and that we are aliens and strangers in this world (1 Peter 2:11). But does that mean we should leave governing to unbelievers? Should we invest our time in influencing what seems transitory at best?

The answer is simple: Jesus commanded us to be the salt and light of the world (Matthew 5:13-14). As Christians, we are called to preserve the spiritual and moral fabric of society wherever God has placed us. And that includes influencing every aspect of our culture--entertainment, business, education, and yes, even government.

| | As the upcoming election approaches, how should we allow the Bible to guide our decisions? In my new 44-page booklet, _How a Christian Should Vote_ , I offer a biblical framework for assessing candidates, their faith, policies, and constitutional views. This practical resource will help you view the election from a biblical perspective, equipping you to make informed decisions.

Do the candidate's policies align with the Bible?
What is the candidate's view of Israel?
Will the candidate get things done?
